3.7.76.s: nirṇijya srucaṃ niṣṭapyādbhiḥ pūrayitvodag uddiśati saptarṣīn prīṇīhi saptarṣīñ jinva saptarṣibhyaḥ svāhā | iti
3.7.76.d: निर्णिज्य स्रुचं निष्टप्याद्भिः पूरयित्वोदग् उद्दिशति सप्तर्षीन् प्रीणीहि सप्तर्षीञ् जिन्व सप्तर्षिभ्यः स्वाहा । इति
3.7.76.m: Having washed the offering ladle, heated it [over the fire], and filled it with water, he points it to the north, [saying,] “Please the Seven Seers, quicken the Seven Seers, to the Seven Seers svāhā!”

3.7.76.s: saptarṣīn eva prīṇāti | iti brāhmaṇam atha jaghanena gārhapatyam apo ninayati | idam aham agnau vaiśvānare 'mṛtaṃ juhomi svāhā | iti |
3.7.76.d: सप्तर्षीन् एव प्रीणाति । इति ब्राह्मणम् अथ जघनेन गार्हपत्यम् अपो निनयति । इदम् अहम् अग्नौ वैश्वानरे ऽमृतं जुहोमि स्वाहा । इति ।
3.7.76.m:
“He pleases indeed the Seven Seers,” says the brāhmaṇa passage.
Then behind the gārhapatya fire he pours out water, [saying,] “Here do I offer nectar into Agni Vaiśvānara, svāhā!”

3.7.76.s: akṣityām akṣitāhutiṃ juhomi svāhā | ity antarvedi ninayati
3.7.76.d: अक्षित्याम् अक्षिताहुतिं जुहोमि स्वाहा । इत्य् अन्तर्वेदि निनयति
3.7.76.m: “Into the imperishable do I offer an imperishable oblation, svāhā!”—[with these words] he pours it within the altar.
“Having offered, he kindles [the fire] for the kindling of spiritual radiance.”

3.7.76.s: apo ninayaty avabhṛthasyaiva rūpam akar iti brāhmaṇam ||
3.7.76.d: अपो निनयत्य् अवभृथस्यैव रूपम् अकर् इति ब्राह्मणम् ॥
3.7.76.m: “He pours out water; he has made the very form of the final bath,” says the brāhmaṇa passage.

3.8.76.s: atha sāyam̐ hute 'gnihotre yajñopavīty apa ācamya yajamānāyatane tiṣṭhann āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhate | upaprayanto adhvaram iti ṣaḍbhir anucchandasam |
3.8.76.d: अथ सायँ हुते ऽग्निहोत्रे यज्ञोपवीत्य् अप आचम्य यजमानायतने तिष्ठन्न् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते । उपप्रयन्तो अध्वरम् इति षड्भिर् अनुच्छन्दसम् ।
3.8.76.m: Now when the agnihotra has been offered in the evening, having the sacred thread over his shoulder, having sipped water, standing in the sacrificer’s place, he attends upon the āhavanīya fire with the six [verses] following their metre: “Advancing to the rite…”

3.8.76.s: ṣaḍbhir evottarābhir āgnipāvamānībhir āhavanīyam evopatiṣṭhate | agna āyūm̐ṣi pavase | agne pavasva | agne pāvaka sa naḥ pāvaka | agniḥ śucivratatamas | ud agne śucayas tava | iti |
3.8.76.d: षड्भिर् एवोत्तराभिर् आग्निपावमानीभिर् आहवनीयम् एवोपतिष्ठते । अग्न आयूँषि पवसे । अग्ने पवस्व । अग्ने पावक स नः पावक । अग्निः शुचिव्रततमस् । उद् अग्ने शुचयस् तव । इति ।
3.8.76.m: With the subsequent six Agni-Pāvamāna verses he attends upon the āhavanīya fire itself: “O Agni, you purify lifetimes…”; “O Agni, purify…”; “O Agni, the purifier…”; “That purifier for us…”; “Agni of the purest vows…”; “High, O Agni, your pure [flames]…”

3.8.77.s: athāhavanīyam evopatiṣṭhate | āyurdā agne 'si | āyur me dehi varcodā agne 'si varco me dehi tanūpā agne 'si tanuvaṃ me pāhi | agne yan me tanuvā ūnaṃ tan ma āpṛṇa | iti |
3.8.77.d: अथाहवनीयम् एवोपतिष्ठते । आयुर्दा अग्ने ऽसि । आयुर् मे देहि वर्चोदा अग्ने ऽसि वर्चो मे देहि तनूपा अग्ने ऽसि तनुवं मे पाहि । अग्ने यन् मे तनुवा ऊनं तन् म आपृण । इति ।
3.8.77.m: Then he attends upon the āhavanīya fire itself: “You are the giver of lifespan, O Agni; give me lifespan! You are the giver of radiance, O Agni; give me radiance! You are the protector of the body, O Agni; protect my body! O Agni, whatever is lacking in my body, fill that up for me!”

3.8.77.s: atha rātrim upatiṣṭhate citrāvaso svasti te pāram aśīya | iti |
3.8.77.d: अथ रात्रिम् उपतिष्ठते चित्रावसो स्वस्ति ते पारम् अशीय । इति ।
3.8.77.m: Then he attends upon the night: “O you of bright wealth, may I reach your far shore in wellbeing!”

3.8.77.s: athāhavanīye samidham ādadhāti | indhānās tvā śatam̐ himās | dyumantaḥ samidhīmahi vayasvanto vayaskṛtam | yaśasvanto yaśaskṛtam | suvīrāso adābhyam | agne sapatnadambhanam | varṣiṣṭhe adhi nāke svāhā | iti |
3.8.77.d: अथाहवनीये समिधम् आदधाति । इन्धानास् त्वा शतँ हिमास् । द्युमन्तः समिधीमहि वयस्वन्तो वयस्कृतम् । यशस्वन्तो यशस्कृतम् । सुवीरासो अदाभ्यम् । अग्ने सपत्नदम्भनम् । वर्षिष्ठे अधि नाके स्वाहा । इति ।
3.8.77.m: Then he places a kindling stick on the āhavanīya fire: “Kindling you through a hundred winters, / radiant, may we kindle [you]; / full of vigor, [kindling] the vigor-maker; / full of renown, [kindling] the renown-maker; / possessing good heroes, [kindling] the irreproachable one, / O Agni, the crusher of rivals, / upon the highest firmament, svāhā!”

3.8.77.s: athāhavanīyam evopatiṣṭhate saṃ tvamagne sūryasya varcasāgathāḥ samṛṣīṇām̐ stutena saṃ priyeṇa dhāmnā || tvam agne sūryavarcā asi saṃ mām āyuṣā varcasā prajayā sṛja | iti |
3.8.77.d: अथाहवनीयम् एवोपतिष्ठते सं त्वमग्ने सूर्यस्य वर्चसागथाः समृषीणाँ स्तुतेन सं प्रियेण धाम्ना ॥ त्वम् अग्ने सूर्यवर्चा असि सं माम् आयुषा वर्चसा प्रजया सृज । इति ।
3.8.77.m: Then he attends upon the āhavanīya fire itself: “You have united, O Agni, with the radiance of the sun, with the praise of the seers, with the beloved abode; // you, O Agni, have the radiance of the sun; unite me with lifespan, radiance, and offspring!”

3.8.77.s: yathā vai puruṣo 'śvo gaur jīryaty evam agnir āhito jīryati saṃvatsarasya parastād āgnipāvamānībhir upatiṣṭhate | iti
3.8.77.d: यथा वै पुरुषो ऽश्वो गौर् जीर्यत्य् एवम् अग्निर् आहितो जीर्यति संवत्सरस्य परस्ताद् आग्निपावमानीभिर् उपतिष्ठते । इति
3.8.77.m: “Just as a man, a horse, or an ox grows old, so Agni, when set up, grows old; after a year he attends upon it with the Agni-Pāvamāna verses.”

3.8.77.s: sa saṃvatsarasya parastād āgnipāvamānībhir gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate
3.8.77.d: स संवत्सरस्य परस्ताद् आग्निपावमानीभिर् गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते
3.8.77.m: After a year he attends upon the gārhapatya fire with the Agni-Pāvamāna verses.

3.8.77.s: punarnavam evainam ajaraṃ karoti | iti brāhmaṇam
3.8.77.d: पुनर्नवम् एवैनम् अजरं करोति । इति ब्राह्मणम्
3.8.77.m: “He makes it made-anew, ageless,” says the brāhmaṇa passage.

3.8.77.s: atha gṛhām̐ś ca paśūm̐ś copatiṣṭhate saṃpaśyāmi prajā aham iḍaprajaso mānavīḥ | sarvā bhavantu no gṛhe || ambha sthāmbho vo bhakṣīya maha stha maho vo bhakṣīya saha stha saho vo bhakṣīyorja sthorjaṃ vo bhakṣīya | revatī ramadhvam asmin loke 'smin goṣṭhe 'smin kṣaye 'smin yonāv ihaiva steto māpa gāta bahvīr me bhūyāsta | iti |
3.8.77.d: अथ गृहाँश् च पशूँश् चोपतिष्ठते संपश्यामि प्रजा अहम् इडप्रजसो मानवीः । सर्वा भवन्तु नो गृहे ॥ अम्भ स्थाम्भो वो भक्षीय मह स्थ महो वो भक्षीय सह स्थ सहो वो भक्षीयोर्ज स्थोर्जं वो भक्षीय । रेवती रमध्वम् अस्मिन् लोके ऽस्मिन् गोष्ठे ऽस्मिन् क्षये ऽस्मिन् योनाव् इहैव स्तेतो माप गात बह्वीर् मे भूयास्त । इति ।
3.8.77.m: Then he attends upon the houses and the cattle: “I look upon offspring, the children of Iḍā, human; / may they all be in our house! // You are waters, may I partake of your water; you are greatness, may I partake of your greatness; you are power, may I partake of your power; you are refreshment, may I partake of your refreshment! / O wealthy ones, rest in this world, in this pen, in this dwelling, in this womb; stay right here, do not depart from here; become manifold for me!”

3.8.78.s: athāgnihotriyai vatsam abhimṛśati sam̐hitāsi viśvarūpīr ā morjā viśā gaupatyenā rāyas poṣeṇa | sahasrapoṣaṃ vaḥ puṣyāsaṃ mayi vo rāyaḥ śrayantām iti |
3.8.78.d: अथाग्निहोत्रियै वत्सम् अभिमृशति सँहितासि विश्वरूपीर् आ मोर्जा विशा गौपत्येना रायस् पोषेण । सहस्रपोषं वः पुष्यासं मयि वो रायः श्रयन्ताम् इति ।
3.8.78.m: Then he touches the calf of the agnihotra cow: “You are joined, multiform; enter me with nourishment, with mastery of cattle, with increase of wealth! / May I thrive with a thousandfold increase of you; may your riches rest in me!”

3.8.78.s: atha dvipadatripadābhir gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate | upa tvāgne divedive doṣāvastar dhiyā vayam | namo bharanta emasi || rājantam adhvarāṇām | gopām ṛtasya dīdivim | vardhamānam̐ sve dame || sa naḥ piteva sūnave agne sūpāyano bhava | sacasvā aḥ svastaye || agne tvaṃ no antamas | uta trātā śivo bhava varūthyaḥ || taṃ tvā śociṣṭha dīdivaḥ sumnāya nūnam īmahe sakhibhyaḥ || vasur agnir vasuśravās | acchā nakṣi dyumattamo rayiṃ dās | iti |
3.8.78.d: अथ द्विपदत्रिपदाभिर् गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते । उप त्वाग्ने दिवेदिवे दोषावस्तर् धिया वयम् । नमो भरन्त एमसि ॥ राजन्तम् अध्वराणाम् । गोपाम् ऋतस्य दीदिविम् । वर्धमानँ स्वे दमे ॥ स नः पितेव सूनवे अग्ने सूपायनो भव । सचस्वा अः स्वस्तये ॥ अग्ने त्वं नो अन्तमस् । उत त्राता शिवो भव वरूथ्यः ॥ तं त्वा शोचिष्ठ दीदिवः सुम्नाय नूनम् ईमहे सखिभ्यः ॥ वसुर् अग्निर् वसुश्रवास् । अच्छा नक्षि द्युमत्तमो रयिं दास् । इति ।
3.8.78.m: Then he attends upon the gārhapatya fire with the two-footed and three-footed verses: “Unto you, O Agni, day by day, / illuminer of darkness, with our thought, / bringing homage, we come; // ruling over the rites, / guardian of cosmic order, shining, / growing in your own home; // so, like a father to his son, / O Agni, be easy of access to us; / abide with us for our wellbeing! // O Agni, you are nearest to us, / and be our savior, kind and protective! // As such, O brightest, radiant one, / we now ask you for benevolence for our friends! // Agni is a goodly giver, of goodly fame; / approach [us], most radiant, give wealth!”
Then he attends upon the houses and the cattle themselves:

3.9.78.s: ūrjā vaḥ paśyāmy ūrjā mā paśyata rāyas poṣeṇa vaḥ paśyāmi rāyas poṣeṇa mā paśyata | iḍā stha madhukṛtaḥ syonā mā viśaterā madaḥ | sahasrapoṣaṃ vaḥ puṣyāsam | mayi vo rāyaḥ śrayantām iti |
3.9.78.d: ऊर्जा वः पश्याम्य् ऊर्जा मा पश्यत रायस् पोषेण वः पश्यामि रायस् पोषेण मा पश्यत । इडा स्थ मधुकृतः स्योना मा विशतेरा मदः । सहस्रपोषं वः पुष्यासम् । मयि वो रायः श्रयन्ताम् इति ।
3.9.78.m: “With nourishment I look upon you, look upon me with nourishment; with increase of wealth I look upon you, look upon me with increase of wealth! / You are Iḍā, honey-makers, enter me gentle, food, delight! / May I thrive with a thousandfold increase of you; / may your riches rest in me!”

3.9.78.s: athāhavanīyam upatiṣṭhate tat savitur vareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt | iti |
3.9.78.d: अथाहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते तत् सवितुर् वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि । धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् । इति ।
3.9.78.m: Then he attends upon the āhavanīya fire: “That excellent splendor of the god Savitar may we meditate upon, / who shall inspire our thoughts!”

3.9.78.s: āhavanīyam evopatiṣṭhate somānam̐ svaraṇaṃ kṛṇuhi brahmaṇas pate | kakṣīvantaṃ ya auśijam iti |
3.9.78.d: आहवनीयम् एवोपतिष्ठते सोमानँ स्वरणं कृणुहि ब्रह्मणस् पते । कक्षीवन्तं य औशिजम् इति ।
3.9.78.m: He attends upon the āhavanīya fire itself: “Make the soma-presser resplendent, O Brahmaṇaspati, / like Kakṣīvat, son of Uśij!”

3.9.78.s: atha rātrim upatiṣṭhate kadā cana starīr asi nendra saścasi dāśuṣe | upopen nu maghavan bhūya in nu te dānaṃ devasya pṛcyate | iti |
3.9.78.d: अथ रात्रिम् उपतिष्ठते कदा चन स्तरीर् असि नेन्द्र सश्चसि दाशुषे । उपोपेन् नु मघवन् भूय इन् नु ते दानं देवस्य पृच्यते । इति ।
3.9.78.m: Then he attends upon the night: “Never are you barren, nor, O Indra, do you fail the worshipper; / ever more and more, O generous one, is your divine gift bestowed!”

3.9.78.s: atha gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate pari tvāgne puraṃ vayaṃ vipram̐ sahasya dhīmahi | dhṛṣadvarṇaṃ divedive bhettāraṃ bhaṅgurāvatas | iti |
3.9.78.d: अथ गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते परि त्वाग्ने पुरं वयं विप्रँ सहस्य धीमहि । धृषद्वर्णं दिवेदिवे भेत्तारं भङ्गुरावतस् । इति ।
3.9.78.m: Then he attends upon the gārhapatya fire: “Around you, O Agni, like a rampart, the sage, the powerful, we place, / of bold hue, day by day, breaker of the deceitful!”

3.9.79.s: atha gārhapatyam evopatiṣṭhate | agne gṛhapate sugṛhapatir ahaṃ tvayā gṛhapatinā bhūyāsam | sugṛhapatir mayā tvaṃ gṛhapatinā bhūyāḥ śatam̐ himās tām āśiṣam āśāse mahyam amuṣmai jyotiṣmatīm | tām āśiṣam āśāse 'muṣmā amuṣmai | iti
3.9.79.d: अथ गार्हपत्यम् एवोपतिष्ठते । अग्ने गृहपते सुगृहपतिर् अहं त्वया गृहपतिना भूयासम् । सुगृहपतिर् मया त्वं गृहपतिना भूयाः शतँ हिमास् ताम् आशिषम् आशासे मह्यम् अमुष्मै ज्योतिष्मतीम् । ताम् आशिषम् आशासे ऽमुष्मा अमुष्मै । इति
3.9.79.m: Then he attends upon the gārhapatya fire itself: “O Agni, lord of the house, may I be a good lord of the house through you, the lord of the house! / May you be a good lord of the house through me, the lord of the house, / for a hundred winters! I pray for that blessing for me, [saying] so-and-so, full of light; / I pray for that blessing for so-and-so, for so-and-so”;

3.9.79.s: yāvanto 'sya putrā jātā bhavanti tantave | ity antatas |
3.9.79.d: यावन्तो ऽस्य पुत्रा जाता भवन्ति तन्तवे । इत्य् अन्ततस् ।
3.9.79.m: for as many sons as are born to him; and at the end: “for the continuation of the lineage.”

3.9.79.s: atha vai bhavati yo vā agniṃ pratyaṅṅ upatiṣṭhate praty enam oṣati yaḥ parāṅ viṣvaṅ prajayā paśubhir eti kavātiryaṅṅ ivopatiṣṭheta | iti
3.9.79.d: अथ वै भवति यो वा अग्निं प्रत्यङ्ङ् उपतिष्ठते प्रत्य् एनम् ओषति यः पराङ् विष्वङ् प्रजया पशुभिर् एति कवातिर्यङ्ङ् इवोपतिष्ठेत । इति
3.9.79.m:
Now indeed it is said:
“Whoever attends upon Agni facing him directly, he burns him; whoever [attends] facing away, disperses in offspring and cattle; he should attend as it were obliquely.”

3.9.79.s: sa kavātiryaṅṅ ivopatiṣṭhate naiva pratyaṅ na parāṅ ||
3.9.79.d: स कवातिर्यङ्ङ् इवोपतिष्ठते नैव प्रत्यङ् न पराङ् ॥
3.9.79.m: He attends as it were obliquely, neither directly facing nor facing away.

3.10.79.s: piṇḍapitṛyajñaṃ kariṣyann upakalpayate sakṛdāchinnaṃ barhir darbhām̐ś ca paristaraṇīyān vrīhīm̐ś ca śūrpaṃ ca prakṣālite colūkhalamusale sthālīm̐ sruvām̐ samekṣaṇām erakopabarhaṇe āñjanābhyañjane daśām̐ sphyam udakumbhaṃ yajñāyudhānīti |
3.10.79.d: पिण्डपितृयज्ञं करिष्यन्न् उपकल्पयते सकृदाछिन्नं बर्हिर् दर्भाँश् च परिस्तरणीयान् व्रीहीँश् च शूर्पं च प्रक्षालिते चोलूखलमुसले स्थालीँ स्रुवाँ समेक्षणाम् एरकोपबर्हणे आञ्जनाभ्यञ्जने दशाँ स्फ्यम् उदकुम्भं यज्ञायुधानीति ।
3.10.79.m: Intending to perform the ancestral ball-offering, he prepares: sacrificial grass cut once, darbha blades to be strewn around, rice grains, a winnowing fan, a washed mortar and pestle, a cooking pot, a ladle with a stirring stick, two reed cushions, eye-salve and ointment, a woolen fringe, a wooden sword, a water-pot, and the sacrificial implements.
Then he strews [grass] around the anvāhāryapacana fire.

3.10.79.s: tam uttareṇaikaikam̐ sam̐sādayaty erakopabarhaṇe āñjanābhyañjane daśām̐ sphyam udakumbhaṃ yajñāyudhānīti |
3.10.79.d: तम् उत्तरेणैकैकँ सँसादयत्य् एरकोपबर्हणे आञ्जनाभ्यञ्जने दशाँ स्फ्यम् उदकुम्भं यज्ञायुधानीति ।
3.10.79.m: To the north of it, he places [the implements] down one by one: the two grass cushions, the eye-salve and ointment, the fringe [of cloth], the wooden sword, the water-jar, and the sacrificial implements.

3.10.79.s: atha prācīnāvītaṃ kṛtvā jaghanenānvāhāryapacanam upaviśya pavitravatyām̐ sthālyāṃ vrīhīn nirvapati pitṛbhyo vo juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi | iti vā tūṣṇīṃ vā |
3.10.79.d: अथ प्राचीनावीतं कृत्वा जघनेनान्वाहार्यपचनम् उपविश्य पवित्रवत्याँ स्थाल्यां व्रीहीन् निर्वपति पितृभ्यो वो जुष्टं निर्वपामि । इति वा तूष्णीं वा ।
3.10.79.m: Then, having worn the sacred cord over the right shoulder and sat down behind the anvāhāryapacana fire, he pours out the rice grains into the pot containing the purifier, either with [the mantra]: "For the fathers, agreeable to you, I pour out", or silently.

3.10.79.s: uparyardhām̐ sthālīṃ kṛtvaitasminn eva carmaṇy ulūkhalamusale nidhāyāvahanti sakṛd eva dakṣiṇāmukhas |
3.10.79.d: उपर्यर्धाँ स्थालीं कृत्वैतस्मिन्न् एव चर्मण्य् उलूखलमुसले निधायावहन्ति सकृद् एव दक्षिणामुखस् ।
3.10.79.m: Having placed the pot on the upper side, having placed the mortar and pestle on that very skin, facing south, he pounds [the grains] only once.

3.10.79.s: athainān avivicya | athaitasyām eva sthālyāṃ tiraḥ pavitram apa ānīyādhiśritya tiraḥ pavitraṃ taṇḍulān āvapati |
3.10.79.d: अथैनान् अविविच्य । अथैतस्याम् एव स्थाल्यां तिरः पवित्रम् अप आनीयाधिश्रित्य तिरः पवित्रं तण्डुलान् आवपति ।
3.10.79.m: Then, without separating them, having poured water into that very pot across the purifier and placed it on [the fire], he scatters the hulled grains across the purifier.

3.10.80.s: athājyaṃ nirvapati | athājyam adhiśrayati | ubhayaṃ paryagni kṛtvā mekṣaṇam̐ sruvaṃ ca saṃmāṛṣṭi |
3.10.80.d: अथाज्यं निर्वपति । अथाज्यम् अधिश्रयति । उभयं पर्यग्नि कृत्वा मेक्षणँ स्रुवं च संमाऋष्टि ।
3.10.80.m: Then he pours out the ghee. Then he places the ghee on the fire. Having carried fire around both, he cleanses the stirring stick and the spoon.
Then, having cooked this boiled mess and basted it, he takes it off [the fire] towards the north.

3.10.80.s: atha yajñopavītaṃ kṛtvānvāhāryapacanam upasamādhāya mekṣaṇenopaghātaṃ tisra āhutīr juhoti somāya pitṛpītāya svadhā namaḥ svāhā yamāyāṅgirasvate pitṛmate svadhā namaḥ svāhā | agnaye kavyavāhanāya sviṣṭakṛte svadhā namaḥ svāhā | iti dakṣiṇārdhapūrvārdhe
3.10.80.d: अथ यज्ञोपवीतं कृत्वान्वाहार्यपचनम् उपसमाधाय मेक्षणेनोपघातं तिस्र आहुतीर् जुहोति सोमाय पितृपीताय स्वधा नमः स्वाहा यमायाङ्गिरस्वते पितृमते स्वधा नमः स्वाहा । अग्नये कव्यवाहनाय स्विष्टकृते स्वधा नमः स्वाहा । इति दक्षिणार्धपूर्वार्धे
3.10.80.m: Then, having worn the sacred cord over the left shoulder and added fuel to the anvāhāryapacana fire, dipping in with the stirring stick, he offers three oblations into the south-eastern part [with the formulas]: "To Soma accompanied by the fathers, svadhā! homage! svāhā!", "To Yama accompanied by the Aṅgirases and the fathers, svadhā! homage! svāhā!", "To Agni the bearer of the kavya offerings, the maker of correct sacrifices, svadhā! homage! svāhā!"

3.10.80.s: tūṣṇīṃ mekṣaṇam abhyādhāya prācīnāvītaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇenānvāhāryapacanam̐ sphyenoddhatyāvokṣya dakṣiṇāgraṃ barhi stīrtvādbhir mārjayati mārjayantāṃ pitaras | mārjayantāṃ pitāmahās | mārjayantāṃ prapitāmahās | iti |
3.10.80.d: तूष्णीं मेक्षणम् अभ्याधाय प्राचीनावीतं कृत्वा दक्षिणेनान्वाहार्यपचनँ स्फ्येनोद्धत्यावोक्ष्य दक्षिणाग्रं बर्हि स्तीर्त्वाद्भिर् मार्जयति मार्जयन्तां पितरस् । मार्जयन्तां पितामहास् । मार्जयन्तां प्रपितामहास् । इति ।
3.10.80.m: Having silently placed the stirring stick on the fire, having worn the sacred cord over the right shoulder, having dug up [the ground] with the wooden sword to the south of the anvāhāryapacana fire and sprinkled it, having strewn the sacrificial grass with its tips towards the south, he purifies [it] with water, saying: "May the fathers purify themselves!", "May the grandfathers purify themselves!", "May the great-grandfathers purify themselves!"

3.10.80.s: atha sruveṇopastīrṇābhighāritām̐s trīn piṇḍān dadāti | etat te tatāsau ye ca tvām anu | etat te pitāmahāsau ye ca tvām anu | etat te prapitāmahāsau ye ca tvām anu | iti |
3.10.80.d: अथ स्रुवेणोपस्तीर्णाभिघारिताँस् त्रीन् पिण्डान् ददाति । एतत् ते ततासौ ये च त्वाम् अनु । एतत् ते पितामहासौ ये च त्वाम् अनु । एतत् ते प्रपितामहासौ ये च त्वाम् अनु । इति ।
3.10.80.m: Then, having spread an under-layer with the spoon and basted [them], he presents three rice balls, saying: "This is for you, father, N.N., and for those who follow you", "This is for you, grandfather, N.N., and for those who follow you", "This is for you, great-grandfather, N.N., and for those who follow you."

3.10.80.s: atra pitaro yathābhāgaṃ mandadhvam ity uktvodaṅ paryāvṛtyoṣmaṇo vyāvṛta upāste
3.10.80.d: अत्र पितरो यथाभागं मन्दध्वम् इत्य् उक्त्वोदङ् पर्यावृत्योष्मणो व्यावृत उपास्ते
3.10.80.m: Having said, "Here, O fathers, rejoice according to your share", having turned towards the north, he sits waiting for the cessation of the steam.

3.10.80.s: vyāvṛt ta ūṣmā | iti prāhus | athābhiparyāvṛtyaitaṃ carum avajighrati ||
3.10.80.d: व्यावृत् त ऊष्मा । इति प्राहुस् । अथाभिपर्यावृत्यैतं चरुम् अवजिघ्रति ॥
3.10.80.m: "The steam has ceased for you", they say. Then, having turned around towards [them], he smells this boiled mess.

3.11.80.s: ye samānāḥ samanasaḥ pitaro yamarājye | teṣāṃ lokaḥ svadhā namo yajño deveṣu kalpatām || ye sajātāḥ samanaso jīvā jīveṣu mām akāḥ | teṣām̐ śrīr mayi kalpatām asmim̐ loke śatam̐ samās | iti |
3.11.80.d: ये समानाः समनसः पितरो यमराज्ये । तेषां लोकः स्वधा नमो यज्ञो देवेषु कल्पताम् ॥ ये सजाताः समनसो जीवा जीवेषु माम् अकाः । तेषाँ श्रीर् मयि कल्पताम् अस्मिँ लोके शतँ समास् । इति ।
3.11.80.m: [With]: "The fathers who are united, like-minded in the realm of Yama, / may their realm, svadhā, homage, [and] sacrifice be prepared among the gods! / The kinsmen who are like-minded, living among the living, who made me; / may their prosperity be prepared for me in this world for a hundred years!"

3.11.80.s: atha tathaivādbhir mārjayati mārjayantāṃ pitaras | mārjayantāṃ pitāmahās | mārjayantāṃ prapitāmahās | iti |
3.11.80.d: अथ तथैवाद्भिर् मार्जयति मार्जयन्तां पितरस् । मार्जयन्तां पितामहास् । मार्जयन्तां प्रपितामहास् । इति ।
3.11.80.m: Then, in the very same way, he purifies with water, saying: "May the fathers purify themselves!", "May the grandfathers purify themselves!", "May the great-grandfathers purify themselves!"

3.11.80.s: athāñjanaṃ dadāti | āñjatāṃ pitaras | āñjatāṃ pitāmahās | āñjatāṃ prapitāmahā | iti |
3.11.80.d: अथाञ्जनं ददाति । आञ्जतां पितरस् । आञ्जतां पितामहास् । आञ्जतां प्रपितामहा । इति ।
3.11.80.m: Then he gives eye-salve, saying: "May the fathers anoint their eyes!", "May the grandfathers anoint their eyes!", "May the great-grandfathers anoint their eyes!"

3.11.80.s: athābhyañjanaṃ dadāti | abhyañjatāṃ pitaras | abhyañjatāṃ pitāmahās | abhyañjtāṃ prapitāmahās | iti |
3.11.80.d: अथाभ्यञ्जनं ददाति । अभ्यञ्जतां पितरस् । अभ्यञ्जतां पितामहास् । अभ्यञ्ज्तां प्रपितामहास् । इति ।
3.11.80.m: Then he gives ointment, saying: "May the fathers anoint themselves!", "May the grandfathers anoint themselves!", "May the great-grandfathers anoint themselves!"

3.11.81.s: atha vāsām̐si dadāti | etāni vaḥ pitaro vāsām̐si | etāni vaḥ pitāmahā vāsām̐si | etāni vaḥ prapitāmahā vāsām̐si | iti |
3.11.81.d: अथ वासाँसि ददाति । एतानि वः पितरो वासाँसि । एतानि वः पितामहा वासाँसि । एतानि वः प्रपितामहा वासाँसि । इति ।
3.11.81.m: Then he gives garments, saying: "These are your garments, O fathers!", "These are your garments, O grandfathers!", "These are your garments, O great-grandfathers!"

3.11.81.s: uttara āyuṣi loma chindīta | iti brāhmaṇam
3.11.81.d: उत्तर आयुषि लोम छिन्दीत । इति ब्राह्मणम्
3.11.81.m: "In later life, he should cut off a tuft of hair", says the brāhmaṇa passage.

3.11.81.s: atha ṣaḍbhir namaskārair viparyāsam upatiṣṭhate namo vaḥ pitaro rasāya namo vaḥ pitaraḥ śuṣmāya namo vaḥ pitaro jīvāya namo vaḥ pitaraḥ svadhāyai namo vaḥ pitaro manyave namo vaḥ pitaro ghorāya pitaro namo vas | ya etasmim̐ loke stha yuṣmām̐s te 'nu ye 'smim̐ loke māṃ te 'nu ya etasmim̐ loke stha yūyaṃ teṣāṃ vasiṣṭhā bhūyāsta ye 'smim̐ loke 'haṃ teṣāṃ vasiṣṭho bhūyāsam iti |
3.11.81.d: अथ षड्भिर् नमस्कारैर् विपर्यासम् उपतिष्ठते नमो वः पितरो रसाय नमो वः पितरः शुष्माय नमो वः पितरो जीवाय नमो वः पितरः स्वधायै नमो वः पितरो मन्यवे नमो वः पितरो घोराय पितरो नमो वस् । य एतस्मिँ लोके स्थ युष्माँस् ते ऽनु ये ऽस्मिँ लोके मां ते ऽनु य एतस्मिँ लोके स्थ यूयं तेषां वसिष्ठा भूयास्त ये ऽस्मिँ लोके ऽहं तेषां वसिष्ठो भूयासम् इति ।
3.11.81.m: Then with six reverences, he worships in reverse order: "Homage to you, O fathers, for sap! Homage to you, O fathers, for vigour! Homage to you, O fathers, for life! Homage to you, O fathers, for svadhā! Homage to you, O fathers, for fury! Homage to you, O fathers, for dread! O fathers, homage to you! Those who are in that world, they follow you. Those who are in this world, they follow me. Those who are in that world, may you be the best of them. Those who are in this world, may I be the best of them."

3.11.81.s: atha vīraṃ yācate vīraṃ me pitaro datta vīraṃ me pitāmahā datta vīram me prapitāmahā datta pitṛmān ahaṃ yuṣmābhir bhūyāsam̐ suprajaso mayā yūyaṃ bhūyāsta | iti |
3.11.81.d: अथ वीरं याचते वीरं मे पितरो दत्त वीरं मे पितामहा दत्त वीरम् मे प्रपितामहा दत्त पितृमान् अहं युष्माभिर् भूयासँ सुप्रजसो मया यूयं भूयास्त । इति ।
3.11.81.m: Then he asks for a hero[-son]: "Give me a hero, O fathers! Give me a hero, O grandfathers! Give me a hero, O great-grandfathers! Rich in fathers may I be through you; rich in good offspring may you be through me!"

3.11.81.s: athainān utthāpayati | uttiṣṭhata pitaraḥ preta śūrās | yamasya panthām anuyātā purāṇam | dhattād asmāsu draviṇaṃ yac ca bhadram | pra ṇo brūtād bhāgadhān devatāsu | iti |
3.11.81.d: अथैनान् उत्थापयति । उत्तिष्ठत पितरः प्रेत शूरास् । यमस्य पन्थाम् अनुयाता पुराणम् । धत्ताद् अस्मासु द्रविणं यच् च भद्रम् । प्र णो ब्रूताद् भागधान् देवतासु । इति ।
3.11.81.m: Then he makes them rise up: "Rise up, O fathers, depart, O heroes, / follow the ancient path of Yama! / Bestow wealth on us and whatever is auspicious, / and proclaim us as having shares among the deities!"

3.11.81.s: athainān sam̐sādhayati yantu pitaro yathālokaṃ manasā javena pareta pitaraḥ somyās gambhīraiḥ pathibhiḥ pūrvyaiḥ | athā pitṝnt suvidatrām̐ apīta yamena ye sadhamādaṃ madanti | iti |
3.11.81.d: अथैनान् सँसाधयति यन्तु पितरो यथालोकं मनसा जवेन परेत पितरः सोम्यास् गम्भीरैः पथिभिः पूर्व्यैः । अथा पितॄन्त् सुविदत्राँ अपीत यमेन ये सधमादं मदन्ति । इति ।
3.11.81.m: Then he sends them away: "May the fathers go to their respective world with mental speed. Depart, O Soma-loving fathers, by deep ancient paths; then go to the benevolent fathers who rejoice in common revelry with Yama."

3.11.81.s: atha tisṛbhir mana āhvayate mano nv āhuvāmahe | ā na etu manaḥ punar | punar naḥ pitaro manas | iti |
3.11.81.d: अथ तिसृभिर् मन आह्वयते मनो न्व् आहुवामहे । आ न एतु मनः पुनर् । पुनर् नः पितरो मनस् । इति ।
3.11.81.m: Then with three [verses] he summons the mind: "Now we summon the mind...", "May mind return to us again...", "Again to us, O fathers, mind..."
Then he throws these rice balls along with the sacrificial grass into the fire.

3.11.81.s: athaiteṣām̐ śastrāṇāṃ dvedve udāharanti | atha yajñopavītaṃ kṛtvā prājāpatyayarcā gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate prajāpate na tvad etāny anyas | iti |
3.11.81.d: अथैतेषाँ शस्त्राणां द्वेद्वे उदाहरन्ति । अथ यज्ञोपवीतं कृत्वा प्राजापत्ययर्चा गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते प्रजापते न त्वद् एतान्य् अन्यस् । इति ।
3.11.81.m: Then, of these recitations, they repeat two each. Then, having worn the sacred cord over the left shoulder, he worships the gārhapatya fire with the verse addressed to Prajāpati: "O Prajāpati, none other than you..."

3.11.82.s: atraitāṃ dvitīyāṃ japati yad antarikṣaṃ pṛthivīm uta dyām iti
3.11.82.d: अत्रैतां द्वितीयां जपति यद् अन्तरिक्षं पृथिवीम् उत द्याम् इति
3.11.82.m: Then he mutters this second [verse]: "Which midspace, earth, and heaven..."

3.12.82.s: varṣāsu śyāmākānām āgrayaṇaṃ kariṣyan bhavati tasya prajñāta upavasathas |
3.12.82.d: वर्षासु श्यामाकानाम् आग्रयणं करिष्यन् भवति तस्य प्रज्ञात उपवसथस् ।
3.12.82.m: When, in the rainy season, he is about to perform the first-fruits sacrifice of wild millet, its fast-day is well known.

3.12.82.s: atha prātar hute 'gnihotre pṛṣṭhyām̐ stīrtvāpaḥ praṇīya saumyam̐ śyāmākaṃ caruṃ nirvapati
3.12.82.d: अथ प्रातर् हुते ऽग्निहोत्रे पृष्ठ्याँ स्तीर्त्वापः प्रणीय सौम्यँ श्यामाकं चरुं निर्वपति
3.12.82.m: Then in the morning, after the agnihotra has been offered, having spread the central line and led forward the waters, he pours out a boiled mess of wild millet for Soma.

3.12.82.s: haviṣkṛtā vācaṃ visṛjya gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīye 'jyānīr juhoti śatāyudhāya śatavīryāya | iti pañca
3.12.82.d: हविष्कृता वाचं विसृज्य गार्हपत्य आज्यं विलाप्योत्पूय स्रुचि चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वाहवनीये ऽज्यानीर् जुहोति शतायुधाय शतवीर्याय । इति पञ्च
3.12.82.m: Having released speech with the call to the preparer of oblation, having melted the ghee on the gārhapatya fire and purified it, having taken four ladlefuls in the offering ladle, he offers five ajyāni libations into the āhavanīya fire with: "To him of a hundred weapons, of a hundred strengths..."

3.12.82.s: tasyāḥ pañcadaśa sāmidhenyaḥ pañca prayājā vārtraghnāv ājyabhāgau |
3.12.82.d: तस्याः पञ्चदश सामिधेन्यः पञ्च प्रयाजा वार्त्रघ्नाव् आज्यभागौ ।
3.12.82.m: For it, there are fifteen kindling verses, five fore-offerings, and the two ghee-portions of Vṛtra-slaying.

3.12.82.s: atha haviṣas | āpyāyasva saṃ te | iti triṣṭubhau saṃyājye
3.12.82.d: अथ हविषस् । आप्यायस्व सं ते । इति त्रिष्टुभौ संयाज्ये
3.12.82.m: Then for the oblation, [the verses are]: "Swell up...", "Together for you..."; the two triṣṭubh verses are the sharing-offerings.

3.12.82.s: anvāhāryam āsādya vāso dadāti | atha yajamānabhāgaṃ prāśnāti | agniḥ prathamaḥ prāśnātu sa hi veda yathā haviḥ | śivā asmabhyam oṣadhīḥ kṛṇotu viśvacarṣaṇis | iti
3.12.82.d: अन्वाहार्यम् आसाद्य वासो ददाति । अथ यजमानभागं प्राश्नाति । अग्निः प्रथमः प्राश्नातु स हि वेद यथा हविः । शिवा अस्मभ्यम् ओषधीः कृणोतु विश्वचर्षणिस् । इति
3.12.82.m: Having brought forward the anvāhārya cooked rice, he gives a garment. Then he eats the sacrificer's share, saying: "May Agni eat first; he indeed knows how the oblation [should be]. May he, who belongs to all peoples, make the plants auspicious for us."
This sacrifice concludes with the full-cup libation and the steps of Viṣṇu.

3.12.82.s: visṛjate vratam atha śaradi vrīhīṇām āgrayaṇaṃ kariṣyan bhavati
3.12.82.d: विसृजते व्रतम् अथ शरदि व्रीहीणाम् आग्रयणं करिष्यन् भवति
3.12.82.m: He releases the observance. Then, in autumn, he is about to perform the first-fruits sacrifice of rice.

3.12.82.s: tasya prajñāta upavasathas | atha prātar hute 'gnihotre pṛṣṭhyām̐ stīrtvāpaḥ praṇīyaindrāgnaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati vaiśvadevaṃ caruṃ dyāvāpṛthivyam ekakapālam iti
3.12.82.d: तस्य प्रज्ञात उपवसथस् । अथ प्रातर् हुते ऽग्निहोत्रे पृष्ठ्याँ स्तीर्त्वापः प्रणीयैन्द्राग्नं द्वादशकपालं निर्वपति वैश्वदेवं चरुं द्यावापृथिव्यम् एककपालम् इति
3.12.82.m: Its fast-day is well known. Then in the morning, after the agnihotra has been offered, having spread the central line and led forward the waters, he pours out [the grains for] a cake on twelve potsherds for Indra and Agni, a boiled mess for the All-gods, and a cake on one potsherd for Heaven and Earth.

3.12.82.s: haviṣvṛtā vācaṃ visṛjya gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya sruci caturgṛḥtaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīye 'jyānīr juhoti śatāyudhāya śatavīryāya | iti pañca
3.12.82.d: हविष्वृता वाचं विसृज्य गार्हपत्य आज्यं विलाप्योत्पूय स्रुचि चतुर्गृःतं गृहीत्वाहवनीये ऽज्यानीर् जुहोति शतायुधाय शतवीर्याय । इति पञ्च
3.12.82.m: Having released speech with the haviṣkṛt call, having melted ghee over the gārhapatya [fire] and purified it, having taken four ladlings into the ladle, he offers the ajyānī offerings in the āhavanīya [fire] with the five [mantras]: 'To him who has a hundred weapons, to him who has a hundred powers...'

3.12.82.s: śrapayitvāsādayati tasyāḥ pañcadaśa sāmidhenyaḥ pañca prayājā vārtraghnāv ājyabhāgau |
3.12.82.d: श्रपयित्वासादयति तस्याः पञ्चदश सामिधेन्यः पञ्च प्रयाजा वार्त्रघ्नाव् आज्यभागौ ।
3.12.82.m: Having cooked [them], he places [them] down. There are fifteen kindling verses for it, five fore-offerings, [and] the two butter portions belonging to Vṛtra-slayer.

3.12.82.s: atha haviṣām indrāgnī rocanā divaḥ śnathad vṛtram ity aindrāgnasya
3.12.82.d: अथ हविषाम् इन्द्राग्नी रोचना दिवः श्नथद् वृत्रम् इत्य् ऐन्द्राग्नस्य
3.12.82.m: Then for the oblations: 'Indra and Agni, lights of heaven...' [and] 'He smashed Vṛtra...' are for the offering to Indra and Agni.

3.12.82.s: viśve devās | viśve devās | iti vaiśvadevasya
3.12.82.d: विश्वे देवास् । विश्वे देवास् । इति वैश्वदेवस्य
3.12.82.m: 'All gods...' [and] 'All gods...' are for the offering to the All-gods.

3.12.83.s: dyāvā naḥ pṛthivī pra pūrvaje pitarā | iti dyāvāpṛthivyasya triṣṭubhau saṃyāje
3.12.83.d: द्यावा नः पृथिवी प्र पूर्वजे पितरा । इति द्यावापृथिव्यस्य त्रिष्टुभौ संयाजे
3.12.83.m: 'May Heaven and Earth to us...' [and] 'Forth the two ancient parents...' are for the offering to Heaven and Earth. The two offering verses are in the triṣṭubh metre.

3.12.83.s: anvāhāryam āsādya prathamajaṃ vatsaṃ dadāti | atha yajamānabhāgaṃ prāśnāti bhadrān naḥ śreyaḥ samanaiṣṭa devās tvayāvasena sam aśīmahi tvā | sa no mayobhūḥ pito ā viśasva śaṃ tokāya tanuve syonas | iti
3.12.83.d: अन्वाहार्यम् आसाद्य प्रथमजं वत्सं ददाति । अथ यजमानभागं प्राश्नाति भद्रान् नः श्रेयः समनैष्ट देवास् त्वयावसेन सम् अशीमहि त्वा । स नो मयोभूः पितो आ विशस्व शं तोकाय तनुवे स्योनस् । इति
3.12.83.m: Having placed down the anvāhārya cooked rice, he gives the first-born calf [as the sacrificial gift]. Then [the sacrificer] consumes the sacrificer's portion with: 'From what is good the gods have guided us to what is better; through you as sustenance may we reach you. Do you, O food, being beneficial to us, enter into [us], propitious to [our] offspring, gentle to [our] body!'
This sacrifice concludes with the full vessel and the Viṣṇu strides. He releases the vow.

3.12.83.s: atha vasante yavānām āgrayaṇaṃ kariṣyan bhavati tasya prajñāta upavasathaḥ
3.12.83.d: अथ वसन्ते यवानाम् आग्रयणं करिष्यन् भवति तस्य प्रज्ञात उपवसथः
3.12.83.m: Now in spring, when he is about to perform the first-fruits sacrifice of barley, its fast-day is well known.

3.12.83.s: samānaṃ karma yathā vrīhyāgrayaṇasya | etāvad eva nānā | atha yajamānabhāgaṃ prāśnāti | etam u tyaṃ madhunā saṃyutaṃ yavam̐ sarasvatyā adhi manāv acarkṛṣuḥ | indra āsīt sīrapatiḥ śatakratuḥ kīnāśā āsan marutaḥ sudānavas | iti
3.12.83.d: समानं कर्म यथा व्रीह्याग्रयणस्य । एतावद् एव नाना । अथ यजमानभागं प्राश्नाति । एतम् उ त्यं मधुना संयुतं यवँ सरस्वत्या अधि मनाव् अचर्कृषुः । इन्द्र आसीत् सीरपतिः शतक्रतुः कीनाशा आसन् मरुतः सुदानवस् । इति
3.12.83.m: The ritual is the same as that of the first-fruits sacrifice of rice. Just this much is different: he consumes the sacrificer's portion with: 'This indeed is that barley mixed with honey which they ploughed on the Sarasvatī under Manu; Indra, of a hundred resolves, was the lord of the plow, the generous Maruts were the plowmen.'
This sacrifice concludes with the full vessel and the Viṣṇu strides.

3.13.83.s: agnibhyaḥ pravatsyan yajñopavīty apa ācamyāgreṇāhavanīyaṃ parītya yajamānāyatane tiṣṭhann āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhate mama nāma prathamaṃ jātavedaḥ pitā māta ca dadhatur yad agre | tat tvaṃ bibhṛhi punar ā mad aitos tavāhaṃ nāma bibhrāṇy agne | iti |
3.13.83.d: अग्निभ्यः प्रवत्स्यन् यज्ञोपवीत्य् अप आचम्याग्रेणाहवनीयं परीत्य यजमानायतने तिष्ठन्न् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते मम नाम प्रथमं जातवेदः पिता मात च दधतुर् यद् अग्रे । तत् त्वं बिभृहि पुनर् आ मद् ऐतोस् तवाहं नाम बिभ्राण्य् अग्ने । इति ।
3.13.83.m: When he is about to set out on a journey away from the fires, having put on the sacred thread over the left shoulder, having sipped water, having walked around in front of the āhavanīya [fire], standing in the sacrificer's seat, he reveres the āhavanīya [fire] with: 'My first name, O Jātavedas, which father and mother gave at first, that do you bear until my return; let me bear your name, O Agni!'

3.13.83.s: agnīnām asakāśe vācaṃ visṛjate so 'dhaḥsaṃveśy amām̐sāśya stryupāyī pravasati
3.13.83.d: अग्नीनाम् असकाशे वाचं विसृजते सो ऽधःसंवेश्य् अमाँसाश्य स्त्र्युपायी प्रवसति
3.13.83.m: Out of sight of the fires, he releases speech. He stays away, sleeping on the ground, not eating meat, and not approaching a woman.
He does not remain away past the twelfth day; he does not bypass the fast-day.

3.13.83.s: āyan prapathe samidhaḥ kurute | agnīn parākhyāya vācaṃ yacchati | āhavanīyam evopatiṣṭhate mama nāma tava ca jātavedo vāsasī iva vivasānau ye carāvaḥ | āyuṣe tvaṃ jīvase vayaṃ yathāyathaṃ viparidadhāvahai punas te | iti |
3.13.83.d: आयन् प्रपथे समिधः कुरुते । अग्नीन् पराख्याय वाचं यच्छति । आहवनीयम् एवोपतिष्ठते मम नाम तव च जातवेदो वाससी इव विवसानौ ये चरावः । आयुषे त्वं जीवसे वयं यथायथं विपरिदधावहै पुनस् ते । इति ।
3.13.83.m: Returning, on the way he gathers kindling sticks. Having caught sight of the fires, he restrains speech. He reveres only the āhavanīya [fire] with: 'My name and yours, O Jātavedas, which we have borne, wandering like two wearing garments: you for long life, we for living, let us exchange again respectively!'

3.13.84.s: atha gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate namo 'gnaye 'pratividdhāya namo 'nādhṛṣṭāya namaḥ samrāje | aṣāḍho agnir bṛhadvayā viśvajit sahantyaḥ śreṣṭho gandharvas | iti |
3.13.84.d: अथ गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते नमो ऽग्नये ऽप्रतिविद्धाय नमो ऽनाधृष्टाय नमः सम्राजे । अषाढो अग्निर् बृहद्वया विश्वजित् सहन्त्यः श्रेष्ठो गन्धर्वस् । इति ।
3.13.84.m: Then he reveres the gārhapatya [fire] with: 'Homage to Agni who cannot be pierced, homage to the unassailable, homage to the sovereign! Agni is invincible, of great vigour, all-conquering, prevailing, the best Gandharva.'

3.13.84.s: athānvāhāryapacanam upatiṣṭhate tvatpitāro agne devās tvāmāhutayas tvadvivācanāḥ | saṃ mām āyuṣa saṃ naupatyena suhite mā dhās | iti |
3.13.84.d: अथान्वाहार्यपचनम् उपतिष्ठते त्वत्पितारो अग्ने देवास् त्वामाहुतयस् त्वद्विवाचनाः । सं माम् आयुष सं नौपत्येन सुहिते मा धास् । इति ।
3.13.84.m: Then he reveres the anvāhāryapacana [fire] with: 'Agni, the gods have you as father; yours are the oblations, yours the arbitrations. Unite me with long life, with wealth of descendants; establish me in well-being!'

3.14.84.s: ayam agniḥ śreṣṭhatamo 'yaṃ bhagavattamo 'yam̐ sahasrasātamaḥ | asmā astu suvīryam iti
3.14.84.d: अयम् अग्निः श्रेष्ठतमो ऽयं भगवत्तमो ऽयँ सहस्रसातमः । अस्मा अस्तु सुवीर्यम् इति
3.14.84.m: 'This Agni is the most excellent, this one is the most prosperous, this one wins thousands the most; to him belong good warriors.'

3.14.84.s: sa yady asmai yajñabhreṣam ācakṣate na te 'hauṣīt | iti tad gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīye saṃtanīṃ juhoti mano jyotir juṣatām ājyam | vicchinnaṃ yajñam̐ sam imaṃ dadhātu | yā iṣṭā uṣaso nimrucaś ca tāḥ saṃdadhāmi haviṣā ghṛtena svāhā | iti |
3.14.84.d: स यद्य् अस्मै यज्ञभ्रेषम् आचक्षते न ते ऽहौषीत् । इति तद् गार्हपत्य आज्यं विलाप्योत्पूय स्रुचि चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वाहवनीये संतनीं जुहोति मनो ज्योतिर् जुषताम् आज्यम् । विच्छिन्नं यज्ञँ सम् इमं दधातु । या इष्टा उषसो निम्रुचश् च ताः संदधामि हविषा घृतेन स्वाहा । इति ।
3.14.84.m: If they report to him a ritual mishap, saying: '[The priest] has not offered for you', then having melted ghee over the gārhapatya [fire] and purified it, having taken four ladlings into the ladle, he offers the continuity libation into the āhavanīya [fire] with: 'May mind, the light, enjoy the ghee; may it unite this broken sacrifice. Which dawns and sunsets have been sacrificed, those I unite with oblation, with ghee, svāhā!'
Then he prepares a cake on eight potsherds for Agni Tantumat.

3.14.84.s: śarāvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti sā prasiddheṣṭaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate |
3.14.84.d: शरावं दक्षिणां ददाति सा प्रसिद्धेष्टः संतिष्ठते ।
3.14.84.m: He gives a dish [of grain] as the sacrificial gift. That sacrifice concludes in the prescribed manner.

3.14.84.s: athātipannāḥ pratijuhoti | etena ha sma vai pūrve śrotriyā ṛtāyavas tejaskāmā yaśaskāmā brahmavarcasakāmā upatiṣṭhante
3.14.84.d: अथातिपन्नाः प्रतिजुहोति । एतेन ह स्म वै पूर्वे श्रोत्रिया ऋतायवस् तेजस्कामा यशस्कामा ब्रह्मवर्चसकामा उपतिष्ठन्ते
3.14.84.m: Then he offers in compensation for the missed [offerings]. By this [manner], indeed, the ancient learned brāhmaṇas who maintained the cosmic order, desiring brilliance, desiring fame, desiring brāhmanical splendour, used to revere [the fires].

3.14.84.s: tad etad utsannaṃ vratasyaiva garimṇā | athāto vairājam evopasthānam |
3.14.84.d: तद् एतद् उत्सन्नं व्रतस्यैव गरिम्णा । अथातो वैराजम् एवोपस्थानम् ।
3.14.84.m: That [practice] has fallen into disuse solely due to the burden of the vow. Now, therefore, there is only the Vairāja reverence [of the fires].

3.14.84.s: narya prajāṃ me gopāya | iti gārhapatyam atharva pituṃ me gopāya | ity anvāhāryapacanam |
3.14.84.d: नर्य प्रजां मे गोपाय । इति गार्हपत्यम् अथर्व पितुं मे गोपाय । इत्य् अन्वाहार्यपचनम् ।
3.14.84.m: [He reveres] the gārhapatya [fire] with: 'O protector of men, protect my offspring!'; the anvāhāryapacana [fire] with: 'O Atharvan, protect my food!';

3.14.84.s: śam̐sya paśūn me gopāya | ity āhavanīyam |
3.14.84.d: शँस्य पशून् मे गोपाय । इत्य् आहवनीयम् ।
3.14.84.m: the āhavanīya [fire] with: 'O praiseworthy one, protect my livestock!';

3.14.85.s: sapratha sabhāṃ me gopāya | iti sabhyam ahe budhniya mantraṃ me gopāya | ity āvasathīyam |
3.14.85.d: सप्रथ सभां मे गोपाय । इति सभ्यम् अहे बुध्निय मन्त्रं मे गोपाय । इत्य् आवसथीयम् ।
3.14.85.m: the sabhya [fire] with: 'O far-reaching one, protect my assembly!'; the āvasathīya [fire] with: 'O serpent of the deep, protect my sacred mantra!'

3.14.85.s: so 'parimitaṃ pravasati punarāyan prapathe samidhaḥ kurute |
3.14.85.d: सो ऽपरिमितं प्रवसति पुनरायन् प्रपथे समिधः कुरुते ।
3.14.85.m: He may stay away for an unlimited time. Returning, on the way he gathers kindling sticks.
Having caught sight of the fires, he restrains speech. Having arrived, he reveres [them] with this very [formula].

3.15.85.s: athopavasathīye 'han yajñopavīty apa ācamyāgreṇāhavanīyaṃ parītya yajamānāyatana upaviśya tiraḥ pavitram apa ācāmati payasvatīr oṣadhayaḥ payasvad vīrudhāṃ payaḥ | apāṃ payaso yat payas tena mām indra sam̐sṛja | iti |
3.15.85.d: अथोपवसथीये ऽहन् यज्ञोपवीत्य् अप आचम्याग्रेणाहवनीयं परीत्य यजमानायतन उपविश्य तिरः पवित्रम् अप आचामति पयस्वतीर् ओषधयः पयस्वद् वीरुधां पयः । अपां पयसो यत् पयस् तेन माम् इन्द्र सँसृज । इति ।
3.15.85.m: Then on the fast-day, having put on the sacred thread over the left shoulder, having sipped water, having walked around in front of the āhavanīya [fire], having sat down in the sacrificer's seat, he sips water across the purifier with: 'Rich in milk are the plants, rich in milk is the sap of the climbing plants; with that milk which is the milk of the waters, unite me, O Indra!'

3.15.85.s: athāhavanīye samidha ādadhāti | agne vratapate vrataṃ cariṣyāmi tac chakeyam | tan me rādhyatām̐ svāhā vāyo vratapata āditya vratapate vratānāṃ vratapate vrataṃ cariṣyāmi tac chakeyam | tan me rādhyatām̐ svāhā | iti |
3.15.85.d: अथाहवनीये समिध आदधाति । अग्ने व्रतपते व्रतं चरिष्यामि तच् छकेयम् । तन् मे राध्यताँ स्वाहा वायो व्रतपत आदित्य व्रतपते व्रतानां व्रतपते व्रतं चरिष्यामि तच् छकेयम् । तन् मे राध्यताँ स्वाहा । इति ।
3.15.85.m: Then he places kindling sticks into the āhavanīya [fire] with: 'O Agni, lord of vows, I shall observe the vow; may I be capable of it; may that succeed for me, svāhā! O Vāyu, lord of vows, O Āditya, lord of vows, O lord of vows among vows, I shall observe the vow; may I be capable of it; may that succeed for me, svāhā!'

3.15.85.s: atha śvo bhūte havir nirupyamāṇam abhimantrayate | agnim̐ hotāram iha tam̐ huve devān yajñiyān iha yān havāmahe | āyantu devāḥ sumanasyamānās | viyantu devā haviṣo me asya | iti
3.15.85.d: अथ श्वो भूते हविर् निरुप्यमाणम् अभिमन्त्रयते । अग्निँ होतारम् इह तँ हुवे देवान् यज्ञियान् इह यान् हवामहे । आयन्तु देवाः सुमनस्यमानास् । वियन्तु देवा हविषो मे अस्य । इति
3.15.85.m: Then, on the next day, as the oblation is being portioned out, he addresses it with: 'I call Agni the hotṛ priest here, those gods worthy of sacrifice whom we call here. May the gods come well-disposed; may the gods partake of this oblation of mine.'

3.15.85.s: tad uditvā vācaṃ yacchaty ā haviṣkṛtas | haviṣkṛtā vācaṃ visṛjya yajñaṃ yogena yunakti kas tvā yunakti sa tvā yunaktu | iti
3.15.85.d: तद् उदित्वा वाचं यच्छत्य् आ हविष्कृतस् । हविष्कृता वाचं विसृज्य यज्ञं योगेन युनक्ति कस् त्वा युनक्ति स त्वा युनक्तु । इति
3.15.85.m: Having spoken that, he restrains speech until the haviṣkṛt call. Having released speech with the haviṣkṛt call, he harnesses the sacrifice with the harnessing formula: 'Who harnesses you? May he harness you...'

3.15.85.s: kāle kapālāni yunakti yāni gharme kapālāny upacinvanti vedhasaḥ | pūṣṇas tāny api vrata indravāyū yuṅktām iti
3.15.85.d: काले कपालानि युनक्ति यानि घर्मे कपालान्य् उपचिन्वन्ति वेधसः । पूष्णस् तान्य् अपि व्रत इन्द्रवायू युङ्क्ताम् इति
3.15.85.m: At the proper time, he sets up the potsherds with: 'Which potsherds the wise gather together at the cauldron, those according to the vow of Pūṣan may Indra and Vāyu set up.'

3.15.85.s: teṣāṃ yajuṣkṛtānāṃ yad bhidyate tad utkara udasyati | abhinno gharmo jīradānur yata āttas tad agan punar iti |
3.15.85.d: तेषां यजुष्कृतानां यद् भिद्यते तद् उत्कर उदस्यति । अभिन्नो घर्मो जीरदानुर् यत आत्तस् तद् अगन् पुनर् इति ।
3.15.85.m: If any one of those consecrated with a yajus breaks, he casts that onto the rubbish heap with: 'Unbroken is the cauldron, granting quick gifts; whence it was taken, thither it has gone back.'

3.15.86.s: atha gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīye saṃtanīṃ juhoti | idhmo vediḥ paridhayaś ca sarve yajñasyāyur anusaṃcaranti | trayastrim̐śat tantavo ye vitatnire ya imaṃ yajñam̐ svadhayā dadante teṣāṃ dhinnaṃ praty etad dadhāmi svāhā | iti |
3.15.86.d: अथ गार्हपत्य आज्यं विलाप्योत्पूय स्रुचि चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वाहवनीये संतनीं जुहोति । इध्मो वेदिः परिधयश् च सर्वे यज्ञस्यायुर् अनुसंचरन्ति । त्रयस्त्रिँशत् तन्तवो ये वितत्निरे य इमं यज्ञँ स्वधया ददन्ते तेषां धिन्नं प्रत्य् एतद् दधामि स्वाहा । इति ।
3.15.86.m: Then, having melted ghee over the gārhapatya [fire] and purified it, having taken four ladlings into the ladle, he offers the continuity libation into the āhavanīya [fire] with: 'Kindling wood, altar, and all the enclosing sticks follow the life of the sacrifice; the thirty-three threads which are stretched out, which sustain this sacrifice according to customary share, what is damaged among them I restore here, svāhā!'

3.15.86.s: athānyad apisṛjati gharmo devām̐ apyetu | iti | atha vai bhavati yadi naśyed āśvinaṃ dvikapālaṃ nirvaped dyāvāpṛthivyam ekakapālam iti
3.15.86.d: अथान्यद् अपिसृजति घर्मो देवाँ अप्येतु । इति । अथ वै भवति यदि नश्येद् आश्विनं द्विकपालं निर्वपेद् द्यावापृथिव्यम् एककपालम् इति
3.15.86.m: Then he joins another [potsherd] with: 'May the cauldron go to the gods!' And indeed, there is the passage: 'If it should be lost, he should prepare an offering on two potsherds for the Aśvins and an offering on one potsherd for Heaven and Earth.'

3.15.86.s: sā prasiddheṣṭiḥ saṃtiṣṭhate | atha tathaiva gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvāhavanīye saṃtanīṃ juhoti | idhmo vediḥ paridhayaś ca sarve yajñasyāyur anusaṃcaranti | trayastrim̐śat tantavo ye vitatnire ya imaṃ yajñam̐ svadhayā dadante teṣāṃ chinnaṃ praty etad dadhāmi svāhā | iti |
3.15.86.d: सा प्रसिद्धेष्टिः संतिष्ठते । अथ तथैव गार्हपत्य आज्यं विलाप्योत्पूय स्रुचि चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वाहवनीये संतनीं जुहोति । इध्मो वेदिः परिधयश् च सर्वे यज्ञस्यायुर् अनुसंचरन्ति । त्रयस्त्रिँशत् तन्तवो ये वितत्निरे य इमं यज्ञँ स्वधया ददन्ते तेषां छिन्नं प्रत्य् एतद् दधामि स्वाहा । इति ।
3.15.86.m: That rite is concluded in the established manner. Then in the very same way, having melted the clarified butter over the gārhapatya fire, having purified it, and having taken four ladlefuls into the ladle, he offers the connecting oblation into the āhavanīya fire with: 'The kindling wood, the altar, and all the enclosing sticks follow the lifespan of the sacrifice. / The thirty-three threads which were stretched out, who uphold this sacrifice by ancestral food: what of theirs is severed, I here reconnect, svāhā!'

3.15.86.s: athānyad apisṛjati gharmo devām̐ apy etu | iti | atha yady ājyasya vā sāṃnāyyasya vānyatra barhiṣaḥ purottamāt prayājāt skandati tasya svadhām̐ saṃbharati ||
3.15.86.d: अथान्यद् अपिसृजति घर्मो देवाँ अप्य् एतु । इति । अथ यद्य् आज्यस्य वा सांनाय्यस्य वान्यत्र बर्हिषः पुरोत्तमात् प्रयाजात् स्कन्दति तस्य स्वधाँ संभरति ॥
3.15.86.m: Then he throws the other in with: 'May the hot offering go to the gods!' Now, if any of the clarified butter or of the curd-and-milk oblation spills outside the sacrificial grass before the final fore-offering, he gathers its essence:

3.16.86.s: saṃ tvā siñcāmi yajuṣā prajām āyur dhanaṃ ca | bṛhaspatiprasūto yajamāna iha mā riṣat | iti
3.16.86.d: सं त्वा सिञ्चामि यजुषा प्रजाम् आयुर् धनं च । बृहस्पतिप्रसूतो यजमान इह मा रिषत् । इति
3.16.86.m: 'I pour you together with a yajus, [granting] offspring, lifespan, and wealth. / Impelled by Bṛhaspati, may the sacrificer not come to harm here.'

3.16.86.s: skannam anumantrayate bhūpataye svāhā bhuvanapataye svāhā bhūtānāṃ pataye svāhā | iti |
3.16.86.d: स्कन्नम् अनुमन्त्रयते भूपतये स्वाहा भुवनपतये स्वाहा भूतानां पतये स्वाहा । इति ।
3.16.86.m: He consecrates what has spilled with: 'To the lord of the earth, svāhā! To the lord of the world, svāhā! To the lord of beings, svāhā!'

3.16.86.s: atha yāvat pariśiṣṭena pracaraty atha yajamānam ājyam avekṣayati | ājayam asi satyam asi satyasyādhyakṣam asi havir asi vaiśvānaraṃ vaiśvadevam utpūtaśuṣmam̐ satyaujāḥ saho 'si sahamānam asi sahasvārātīḥ sahasvārātīyataḥ sahasva pṛtanāḥ sahasva pṛtanyataḥ sahasravīryam asi tan mā jinva | ājyasyājyam asi satyasya satyam asi satyāyur asi satyaśuṣmam asi satyena tvābhighārayāmi tasya te bhakṣīya | iti |
3.16.86.d: अथ यावत् परिशिष्टेन प्रचरत्य् अथ यजमानम् आज्यम् अवेक्षयति । आजयम् असि सत्यम् असि सत्यस्याध्यक्षम् असि हविर् असि वैश्वानरं वैश्वदेवम् उत्पूतशुष्मँ सत्यौजाः सहो ऽसि सहमानम् असि सहस्वारातीः सहस्वारातीयतः सहस्व पृतनाः सहस्व पृतन्यतः सहस्रवीर्यम् असि तन् मा जिन्व । आज्यस्याज्यम् असि सत्यस्य सत्यम् असि सत्यायुर् असि सत्यशुष्मम् असि सत्येन त्वाभिघारयामि तस्य ते भक्षीय । इति ।
3.16.86.m: Then, as long as he proceeds with what remains, he makes the sacrificer look at the clarified butter: 'You are victorious. You are truth. You are the overseer of truth. You are an oblation belonging to Vaiśvānara, belonging to All-Gods, whose vigor is purified, possessing true power. You are power. You are conquering. Conquer the enemies! Conquer those who act as enemies! Conquer the hosts! Conquer those who fight against us! You are of thousandfold vigor. Therefore invigorate me! You are the clarified butter of clarified butter. You are the truth of truth. You are true life. You are true vigor. With truth I sprinkle you. May I partake of you.'

3.16.87.s: athājyagrahāṇām | gṛhītaṃgṛhītam anumantrayate pañcānāṃ tvā vātānāṃ yantrāya dhartrāya gṛhṇāmi pañcānāṃ tvartūnāṃ yantrāya dhartrāya gṛhṇāmi pañcanāṃ tvā diśāṃ yantrāya dhartrāya gṛhṇāmi pañcānāṃ tvā pañcajanānāṃ yantrāya dhartrāya gṛhṇāmi | iti caturbhir juhūm
3.16.87.d: अथाज्यग्रहाणाम् । गृहीतंगृहीतम् अनुमन्त्रयते पञ्चानां त्वा वातानां यन्त्राय धर्त्राय गृह्णामि पञ्चानां त्वर्तूनां यन्त्राय धर्त्राय गृह्णामि पञ्चनां त्वा दिशां यन्त्राय धर्त्राय गृह्णामि पञ्चानां त्वा पञ्चजनानां यन्त्राय धर्त्राय गृह्णामि । इति चतुर्भिर् जुहूम्
3.16.87.m: Then of the ladlefuls of clarified butter, he consecrates each one taken: 'For the restraint, for the support of the five winds I take you. For the restraint, for the support of the five seasons I take you. For the restraint, for the support of the five quarters I take you. For the restraint, for the support of the five tribes I take you'—with four formulas [for] the juhū ladle;

3.16.87.s: aṣṭābhir upabhṛtam | caros tvā pañcabilasya yantrāya dhartrāya gṛhṇāmi brahmaṇas tvā tejase yantrāya dhartrāya gṛhṇāmi kṣatrasya tvaujase yantrāya dhartrāya gṛhṇāmi viśe tvā yantrāya dhartrāya gṛhṇāmi suvīryāya tvā gṛhṇāmi suprajāstvāya tvā gṛhṇāmi rāyas poṣāya tvā gṛhṇāmi brahmavarcasāya tvā gṛhṇāmi | iti
3.16.87.d: अष्टाभिर् उपभृतम् । चरोस् त्वा पञ्चबिलस्य यन्त्राय धर्त्राय गृह्णामि ब्रह्मणस् त्वा तेजसे यन्त्राय धर्त्राय गृह्णामि क्षत्रस्य त्वौजसे यन्त्राय धर्त्राय गृह्णामि विशे त्वा यन्त्राय धर्त्राय गृह्णामि सुवीर्याय त्वा गृह्णामि सुप्रजास्त्वाय त्वा गृह्णामि रायस् पोषाय त्वा गृह्णामि ब्रह्मवर्चसाय त्वा गृह्णामि । इति
3.16.87.m: with eight [formulas for] the upabhṛt ladle: 'For the restraint, for the support of the five-apertured pot I take you. For the restraint, for the support of the brilliance of the brahman I take you. For the restraint, for the support of the power of the ruling class I take you. For the restraint, for the support of the people I take you. For hero-strength I take you. For good offspring I take you. For the thriving of wealth I take you. For brahmanic luster I take you.'

3.16.87.s: caturbhir dhruvām | bhūr asmākam̐ havir devānām āśiṣo yajamānasya devānāṃ tvā devatābhyo gṛhṇāmi | iti |
3.16.87.d: चतुर्भिर् ध्रुवाम् । भूर् अस्माकँ हविर् देवानाम् आशिषो यजमानस्य देवानां त्वा देवताभ्यो गृह्णामि । इति ।
3.16.87.m: with four [formulas for] the dhruvā ladle: 'Earth is ours, oblation belongs to the gods, blessings to the sacrificer; for the deities of the gods I take you.'

3.16.87.s: abhipūryamāṇām anumantrayate kāmāya tvā gṛhṇāmi | iti
3.16.87.d: अभिपूर्यमाणाम् अनुमन्त्रयते कामाय त्वा गृह्णामि । इति
3.16.87.m: He consecrates it as it is being filled with: 'For desire I take you.'

3.16.87.s: paridhīn paridhīyamānān anumantrayate dhruvo 'si dhruvo 'ham̐ sajāteṣu bhūyāsaṃ dhīraś cettā vasuvid iti madhyam
3.16.87.d: परिधीन् परिधीयमानान् अनुमन्त्रयते ध्रुवो ऽसि ध्रुवो ऽहँ सजातेषु भूयासं धीरश् चेत्ता वसुविद् इति मध्यम्
3.16.87.m: He consecrates the enclosing sticks as they are being laid down: 'Firm are you; firm may I be among my kinsmen, wise, attentive, finding wealth'—[for] the middle one;

3.16.87.s: ugro 'sy ugro 'ham̐ sajāteṣu bhūyāsam ugraś cettā vasuvid iti dakṣiṇam
3.16.87.d: उग्रो ऽस्य् उग्रो ऽहँ सजातेषु भूयासम् उग्रश् चेत्ता वसुविद् इति दक्षिणम्
3.16.87.m: 'Fierce are you; fierce may I be among my kinsmen, fierce, attentive, finding wealth'—[for] the southern one;

3.16.87.s: abhibhūr asy abhibhūr aham̐ sajāteṣu bhūyāsam abhibhūś cettā vasuvid ity uttaram
3.16.87.d: अभिभूर् अस्य् अभिभूर् अहँ सजातेषु भूयासम् अभिभूश् चेत्ता वसुविद् इत्य् उत्तरम्
3.16.87.m: 'Victorious are you; victorious may I be among my kinsmen, victorious, attentive, finding wealth'—[for] the northern one.

3.16.88.s: athāgniṃ yogena yunakti yunajmi tvā brahmaṇā daivyena havyāyāsmai voḍhave jātavedas | iti
3.16.88.d: अथाग्निं योगेन युनक्ति युनज्मि त्वा ब्रह्मणा दैव्येन हव्यायास्मै वोढवे जातवेदस् । इति
3.16.88.m: Then he yokes the fire with the yoking formula: 'I yoke you with the divine brahman to carry this oblation, O Jātavedas.'

3.16.88.s: samidhor abhyādhīyamānayor japati | indhānās tvā suprajasaḥ suvīrā jyog jīvema balihṛto vayaṃ te | iti |
3.16.88.d: समिधोर् अभ्याधीयमानयोर् जपति । इन्धानास् त्वा सुप्रजसः सुवीरा ज्योग् जीवेम बलिहृतो वयं ते । इति ।
3.16.88.m: As two kindling sticks are being placed on, he whispers: 'Kindling you, having good offspring and good heroes, may we live long, bringing tribute to you.'

3.16.88.s: athāntarvedi havīm̐ṣy āsannāny abhimantrayate yan me agne asya yajñasya riṣyād yad vā skandād ājyasyota viṣṇo | tena hanmi sapatnaṃ durmarāyum ainaṃ dadhāmi nirṛtyā upasthe | iti ||
3.16.88.d: अथान्तर्वेदि हवीँष्य् आसन्नान्य् अभिमन्त्रयते यन् मे अग्ने अस्य यज्ञस्य रिष्याद् यद् वा स्कन्दाद् आज्यस्योत विष्णो । तेन हन्मि सपत्नं दुर्मरायुम् ऐनं दधामि निरृत्या उपस्थे । इति ॥
3.16.88.m: Then he addresses the oblations placed within the altar: 'Whatever of this sacrifice of mine may be damaged, O Agni, or whatever of the clarified butter may spill, O Viṣṇu: / therewith I strike down the rival who seeks my ruin; I place him in the lap of Nirṛti.'

3.17.88.s: atha bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar iti | agnihotram etābhir vyāhṛtībhir upasādayet |
3.17.88.d: अथ भूर् भुवः सुवर् इति । अग्निहोत्रम् एताभिर् व्याहृतीभिर् उपसादयेत् ।
3.17.88.m: Then: 'Bhūr bhuvas suvar.' 'With these sacred utterances he should set down the agnihotra.'

3.17.88.s: yajñamukhaṃ vā agnihotraṃ brahmaitā vyāhṛtayas | yajñamukha eva brahma kurute
3.17.88.d: यज्ञमुखं वा अग्निहोत्रं ब्रह्मैता व्याहृतयस् । यज्ञमुख एव ब्रह्म कुरुते
3.17.88.m: 'The agnihotra is indeed the face of the sacrifice; these sacred utterances are the brahman.' 'Right at the face of the sacrifice he places the brahman.'

3.17.88.s: saṃvatsare paryāgata etābhir evopasādayet | brahmaṇaivobhayataḥ saṃvatsaraṃ parigṛhṇāti | iti brāhmaṇam
3.17.88.d: संवत्सरे पर्यागत एताभिर् एवोपसादयेत् । ब्रह्मणैवोभयतः संवत्सरं परिगृह्णाति । इति ब्राह्मणम्
3.17.88.m: 'When the year has come round, he should set it down with these very [utterances].' 'With the brahman he grasps the year on both sides'—thus says the brāhmaṇa passage.

3.17.88.s: atha vai bhavati darśapūrṇamāsāv ālabhamāna etābhir vyāhṛtībhir havīm̐ṣy āsādayet |
3.17.88.d: अथ वै भवति दर्शपूर्णमासाव् आलभमान एताभिर् व्याहृतीभिर् हवीँष्य् आसादयेत् ।
3.17.88.m: Now indeed it says: 'Beginning the new and full moon rituals, he should set down the oblations with these sacred utterances.'
'The new and full moon rituals are indeed the face of the sacrifice; these sacred utterances are the brahman.'
'Right at the face of the sacrifice he places the brahman.'

3.17.88.s: saṃvatsare paryāgata etābhir evāsādayet | brahmaṇaivobhayataḥ saṃvatsaraṃ parigṛhṇāti | iti brāhmaṇam
3.17.88.d: संवत्सरे पर्यागत एताभिर् एवासादयेत् । ब्रह्मणैवोभयतः संवत्सरं परिगृह्णाति । इति ब्राह्मणम्
3.17.88.m: 'When the year has come round, he should set them down with these very [utterances].' 'With the brahman he grasps the year on both sides'—thus says the brāhmaṇa passage.

3.17.88.s: atha vai bhavati cāturmāsyāny ālabhamāna etābhir vyāhṛtībhir havīm̐ṣy āsādayet |
3.17.88.d: अथ वै भवति चातुर्मास्यान्य् आलभमान एताभिर् व्याहृतीभिर् हवीँष्य् आसादयेत् ।
3.17.88.m: Now indeed it says: 'Beginning the four-month rituals, he should set down the oblations with these sacred utterances.'
'The four-month rituals are indeed the face of the sacrifice; these sacred utterances are the brahman.'

3.17.88.s: yajñamukha eva brahma kurute saṃvatsare paryāgata etābhir evāsādayet |
3.17.88.d: यज्ञमुख एव ब्रह्म कुरुते संवत्सरे पर्यागत एताभिर् एवासादयेत् ।
3.17.88.m: 'Right at the face of the sacrifice he places the brahman. When the year has come round, he should set them down with these very [utterances].'
'With the brahman he grasps the year on both sides'—thus says the brāhmaṇa passage.

3.17.88.s: atha vai bhavati yad vai yajñasya sāmnā kriyate rāṣṭraṃ yajñasyāśīr gacchati yad ṛcā viśaṃ yajñasyāśīr gacchati |
3.17.88.d: अथ वै भवति यद् वै यज्ञस्य साम्ना क्रियते राष्ट्रं यज्ञस्याशीर् गच्छति यद् ऋचा विशं यज्ञस्याशीर् गच्छति ।
3.17.88.m: Now indeed it says: 'What in the sacrifice is performed with a saman, the blessing of the sacrifice goes to the realm; what with a ṛc, the blessing of the sacrifice goes to the people.'
'Now the brāhmaṇa sacrifices with a sacrifice devoid of blessings.'

3.17.88.s: sāmidhenīr anuvakṣyann etā vyāhṛtīḥ purastād dadhyāt |
3.17.88.d: सामिधेनीर् अनुवक्ष्यन्न् एता व्याहृतीः पुरस्ताद् दध्यात् ।
3.17.88.m: 'About to recite the kindling verses, he should place these sacred utterances in front.'

3.17.88.s: brahmaiva pratipadaṃ kurute tathā brāmaṇaḥ sāśīrkeṇa yajñena yajate | iti brāhmaṇam
3.17.88.d: ब्रह्मैव प्रतिपदं कुरुते तथा ब्रामणः साशीर्केण यज्ञेन यजते । इति ब्राह्मणम्
3.17.88.m: 'He makes the brahman itself the introductory verse.' 'Thus the brāhmaṇa sacrifices with a sacrifice possessing blessings'—thus says the brāhmaṇa passage.

3.17.89.s: atha vai bhavati yaṃ kāmayeta yajamānaṃ bhrātṛvyam asya yajñasyāśīr gacched iti tasyaitā vyāhṛtīḥ puro'nuvākyāyāṃ dadhyāt |
3.17.89.d: अथ वै भवति यं कामयेत यजमानं भ्रातृव्यम् अस्य यज्ञस्याशीर् गच्छेद् इति तस्यैता व्याहृतीः पुरोऽनुवाक्यायां दध्यात् ।
3.17.89.m: Now indeed it says: 'For whatever sacrificer he might wish: "May the blessing of this sacrifice go to his rival," he should insert these sacred utterances into his introductory verse.'

3.17.89.s: bhrātṛvyadevatyā vai puro'nuvākyā bhrātṛvyam evāsya yajñasyāśīr gacchati | iti brāhmaṇam
3.17.89.d: भ्रातृव्यदेवत्या वै पुरोऽनुवाक्या भ्रातृव्यम् एवास्य यज्ञस्याशीर् गच्छति । इति ब्राह्मणम्
3.17.89.m: 'The introductory verse belongs to the rival deity.' 'The blessing of his sacrifice goes to the rival'—thus says the brāhmaṇa passage.

3.17.89.s: atha vai bhavati yān kāmayeta yajamānānt samāvaty enān yajñasyāśīr gacched iti teṣām etā vyāhṛtīḥ puro'nuvākyāyā ardharca ekāṃ dadhyād yājyāyai purastād ekāṃ yājyāyā ardharca ekāṃ
3.17.89.d: अथ वै भवति यान् कामयेत यजमानान्त् समावत्य् एनान् यज्ञस्याशीर् गच्छेद् इति तेषाम् एता व्याहृतीः पुरोऽनुवाक्याया अर्धर्च एकां दध्याद् याज्यायै पुरस्ताद् एकां याज्याया अर्धर्च एकां
3.17.89.m: Now indeed it says: 'For whichever sacrificers he might wish: "May the blessing of the sacrifice go equally to them," of theirs he should insert one of these sacred utterances at the half-verse of the introductory verse, one before the offering verse, and one at the half-verse of the offering verse.'

3.17.89.s: tathainānt samāvatī yajñasyāśīr gacchati | iti brāhmaṇam atha vai bhavati
3.17.89.d: तथैनान्त् समावती यज्ञस्याशीर् गच्छति । इति ब्राह्मणम् अथ वै भवति
3.17.89.m: 'Thus the blessing of the sacrifice goes equally to them'—thus says the brāhmaṇa passage. Now indeed it says:

3.17.89.s: yathā vai parjanyaḥ suvṛṣṭaḥ varṣaty evaṃ yajño yajamānāya varṣati
3.17.89.d: यथा वै पर्जन्यः सुवृष्टः वर्षत्य् एवं यज्ञो यजमानाय वर्षति
3.17.89.m: 'Just as Parjanya rains a good rain, so the sacrifice rains for the sacrificer.'

3.17.89.s: sthalayodakaṃ parigṛhṇanti | āśiṣā yajñaṃ yajamānaḥ parigṛhṇāti | iti brāhmaṇam |
3.17.89.d: स्थलयोदकं परिगृह्णन्ति । आशिषा यज्ञं यजमानः परिगृह्णाति । इति ब्राह्मणम् ।
3.17.89.m: 'With a reservoir they hold the water.' 'With a blessing the sacrificer holds the sacrifice'—thus says the brāhmaṇa passage.

3.17.89.s: vyāhṛtībhir brāhmaṇasya pratipadyate hiṅkāreṇa rājanyasyarcā vaiśyasya sarvam evaitat trayaṃ kuryād ity etad aparam
3.17.89.d: व्याहृतीभिर् ब्राह्मणस्य प्रतिपद्यते हिङ्कारेण राजन्यस्यर्चा वैश्यस्य सर्वम् एवैतत् त्रयं कुर्याद् इत्य् एतद् अपरम्
3.17.89.m: With the sacred utterances he begins for a brāhmaṇa; with the hiṅ-sound for a nobleman; with a ṛc for a vaiśya. 'He should perform all three of these,' so says another [tradition].
He consecrates the kindling wood as it is being laid on:

3.18.89.s: ucchuṣmo agne yajamānāyaidhi niśuṣmo abhidāsate | agne deveddha manviddha mandrajihva | iti
3.18.89.d: उच्छुष्मो अग्ने यजमानायैधि निशुष्मो अभिदासते । अग्ने देवेद्ध मन्विद्ध मन्द्रजिह्व । इति
3.18.89.m: 'Be high-spirited for the sacrificer, O Agni, [and] low-spirited for the one who assails him! / O Agni, kindled by the gods, kindled by Manu, having a charming tongue!'

3.18.89.s: pravaraṃ pravriyamāṇam anumantrayate | amartyasya te hotar mūrdhann ājigharmi rāyas poṣāya suprajāstvāya suvīryāya | iti
3.18.89.d: प्रवरं प्रव्रियमाणम् अनुमन्त्रयते । अमर्त्यस्य ते होतर् मूर्धन्न् आजिघर्मि रायस् पोषाय सुप्रजास्त्वाय सुवीर्याय । इति
3.18.89.m: While the ancestral invocation is being chosen, he accompanies it with the formula: 'On the head of the immortal hotṛ priest, I sprinkle thee for the increase of wealth, for good offspring, for heroic strength.'

3.18.89.s: sruveṇāghāram āghāryamāṇam anumantrayate mano 'si prajāpatyaṃ manasā mā bhūtenāviśa | iti
3.18.89.d: स्रुवेणाघारम् आघार्यमाणम् अनुमन्त्रयते मनो ऽसि प्रजापत्यं मनसा मा भूतेनाविश । इति
3.18.89.m: While the libation is being poured with the dipping spoon, he accompanies it with: 'Thou art the mind belonging to Prajāpati; enter me with mind, with being!'

3.18.89.s: srucyam āghāram āghāryamāṇam anumantrayate vāg asy aindrī sapatnakṣayaṇī vācā mendriyeṇāviśa | iti
3.18.89.d: स्रुच्यम् आघारम् आघार्यमाणम् अनुमन्त्रयते वाग् अस्य् ऐन्द्री सपत्नक्षयणी वाचा मेन्द्रियेणाविश । इति
3.18.89.m: While the libation is being poured with the offering ladle, he accompanies it with: 'Thou art the voice belonging to Indra, slaying rivals; enter me with voice, with indriya-power!'

3.18.89.s: prayājānām iṣṭamiṣṭam anumantrayate vasantam ṛtūnāṃ prīṇāmi sa mā prītaḥ prīṇātu grīṣmam ṛtūnāṃ prīṇāmi sa mā prītaḥ prīṇātu varṣā ṛtūnāṃ prīṇāmi tā mā prītāḥ prīṇantu śaradam ṛtūnāṃ prīṇāmi sā mā prītā prīṇātu hemantaśiśirāv ṛtūnāṃ prīṇāmi tau mā prītau prīṇītām iti |
3.18.89.d: प्रयाजानाम् इष्टमिष्टम् अनुमन्त्रयते वसन्तम् ऋतूनां प्रीणामि स मा प्रीतः प्रीणातु ग्रीष्मम् ऋतूनां प्रीणामि स मा प्रीतः प्रीणातु वर्षा ऋतूनां प्रीणामि ता मा प्रीताः प्रीणन्तु शरदम् ऋतूनां प्रीणामि सा मा प्रीता प्रीणातु हेमन्तशिशिराव् ऋतूनां प्रीणामि तौ मा प्रीतौ प्रीणीताम् इति ।
3.18.89.m: He accompanies each of the fore-offerings after it has been offered with: 'I please Spring among the seasons; may it, pleased, please me! I please Summer among the seasons; may it, pleased, please me! I please the Rains among the seasons; may they, pleased, please me! I please Autumn among the seasons; may it, pleased, please me! I please Winter and Cool-season among the seasons; may the two, pleased, please me!'

3.18.90.s: ājyabhāgāv iṣṭāv anumantrayate | agnīṣomayor ahaṃ devayajyayā cakṣuṣmān bhūyāsam iti |
3.18.90.d: आज्यभागाव् इष्टाव् अनुमन्त्रयते । अग्नीषोमयोर् अहं देवयज्यया चक्षुष्मान् भूयासम् इति ।
3.18.90.m: After the two portions of clarified butter have been offered, he accompanies them with: 'Through the worship of the gods Agni and Soma may I become possessed of sight!'

3.18.90.s: agnim iṣṭam anumantrayate | agner ahaṃ devayajyayānnādo bhūyāsam iti |
3.18.90.d: अग्निम् इष्टम् अनुमन्त्रयते । अग्नेर् अहं देवयज्ययान्नादो भूयासम् इति ।
3.18.90.m: After the offering to Agni has been offered, he accompanies it with: 'Through the worship of the god Agni may I become an eater of food!'

3.18.90.s: upām̐śuyājam iṣṭam anumantrayate dabdhir asy adabdho bhūyāsam amuṃ dabheyam iti |
3.18.90.d: उपाँशुयाजम् इष्टम् अनुमन्त्रयते दब्धिर् अस्य् अदब्धो भूयासम् अमुं दभेयम् इति ।
3.18.90.m: After the silent offering has been offered, he accompanies it with: 'Thou art injury; unharmed may I be; may I injure so-and-so!'

3.18.90.s: atra yaṃ yajamāno dveṣṭi taṃ manasā dhyāyati |
3.18.90.d: अत्र यं यजमानो द्वेष्टि तं मनसा ध्यायति ।
3.18.90.m: At this point, whomever the sacrificer hates, he concentrates on him in mind.

3.18.90.s: athāpa upaspṛśya | agnīṣomāv iṣṭāv anumantrayate | agnīṣomayor ahaṃ devayajyayā vṛtrahā bhūyāsam iti |
3.18.90.d: अथाप उपस्पृश्य । अग्नीषोमाव् इष्टाव् अनुमन्त्रयते । अग्नीषोमयोर् अहं देवयज्यया वृत्रहा भूयासम् इति ।
3.18.90.m: Then, having touched water, he accompanies the offering to Agni and Soma after it has been offered with: 'Through the worship of the gods Agni and Soma may I become a slayer of Vṛtra!'

3.18.90.s: indrāgnī iṣṭāv anumantrayate | indrāgniyor ahaṃ devayajyayendriyāvy annādo bhūyāsam iti |
3.18.90.d: इन्द्राग्नी इष्टाव् अनुमन्त्रयते । इन्द्राग्नियोर् अहं देवयज्ययेन्द्रियाव्य् अन्नादो भूयासम् इति ।
3.18.90.m: After the offering to Indra and Agni has been offered, he accompanies it with: 'Through the worship of the gods Indra and Agni may I become possessed of indriya-power, an eater of food!'

3.18.90.s: indram iṣṭam anumantrayate | indrasyāhaṃ devayajyayendriyāvī bhūyāsam iti
3.18.90.d: इन्द्रम् इष्टम् अनुमन्त्रयते । इन्द्रस्याहं देवयज्ययेन्द्रियावी भूयासम् इति
3.18.90.m: After the offering to Indra has been offered, he accompanies it with: 'Through the worship of the god Indra may I become possessed of indriya-power!'

3.18.90.s: mahendram iṣṭam anumantrayate mahendrasyāhaṃ devayajyayā jemānaṃ mahimānaṃ gameyam iti
3.18.90.d: महेन्द्रम् इष्टम् अनुमन्त्रयते महेन्द्रस्याहं देवयज्यया जेमानं महिमानं गमेयम् इति
3.18.90.m: After the offering to Mahendra has been offered, he accompanies it with: 'Through the worship of the god Mahendra may I attain superiority and greatness!'

3.18.90.s: sviṣṭakṛtam iṣṭam anumantrayate | agneḥ sviṣṭakṛto 'haṃ devayajyayāyuṣmān yajñena pratiṣṭhāṃ gameyam iti
3.18.90.d: स्विष्टकृतम् इष्टम् अनुमन्त्रयते । अग्नेः स्विष्टकृतो ऽहं देवयज्ययायुष्मान् यज्ञेन प्रतिष्ठां गमेयम् इति
3.18.90.m: After the offering to Agni Sviṣṭakṛt has been offered, he accompanies it with: 'Through the worship of the god Agni Sviṣṭakṛt may I, possessed of long life, attain stability through the sacrifice!'

3.18.90.s: prāśitre 'vadīyamāne japati | agnir mā duriṣṭāt pātu savitāghaśam̐sāt | iti
3.18.90.d: प्राशित्रे ऽवदीयमाने जपति । अग्निर् मा दुरिष्टात् पातु सविताघशँसात् । इति
3.18.90.m: While the prāśitra portion is being cut off, he mutters: 'May Agni protect me from an ill-offered sacrifice, Savitar from the evil-speaker!'

3.18.90.s: yajamānabhāge yo me 'nti dūre 'rātīyati tam etena jeṣam iti | iḍām āhriyamāṇām anumantrayate surūpavarṣavarṇa ehi | iti pratipadya maghonī | ity ātas |
3.18.90.d: यजमानभागे यो मे ऽन्ति दूरे ऽरातीयति तम् एतेन जेषम् इति । इडाम् आह्रियमाणाम् अनुमन्त्रयते सुरूपवर्षवर्ण एहि । इति प्रतिपद्य मघोनी । इत्य् आतस् ।
3.18.90.m: [While the sacrificer's portion is being cut off, he mutters:] 'Whoever near or far acts as my adversary, may I conquer him with this!' / While the iḍā is being brought forward, he accompanies it, beginning with 'Come, O thou of fair form and rain-colored!', up to 'O bountiful one!'

3.18.90.s: avāntareḍāṃ prāśyamānām anumantrayate juṣṭir asi juṣasva no juṣṭā no 'si juṣṭiṃ te gameyam iti |
3.18.90.d: अवान्तरेडां प्राश्यमानाम् अनुमन्त्रयते जुष्टिर् असि जुषस्व नो जुष्टा नो ऽसि जुष्टिं ते गमेयम् इति ।
3.18.90.m: While the intermediate iḍā is being consumed, he accompanies it with: 'Thou art agreeable; be pleased with us; thou art pleasing to us; may I attain thy favor!'

3.18.90.s: athāntarvedy adbhir mājayate mano jyotir juṣatām ājyam | vicchinnaṃ yajñam̐ sam imaṃ dadhātu | bṛhaspatis tanutām imaṃ no viśve devā iha mādayantām iti
3.18.90.d: अथान्तर्वेद्य् अद्भिर् माजयते मनो ज्योतिर् जुषताम् आज्यम् । विच्छिन्नं यज्ञँ सम् इमं दधातु । बृहस्पतिस् तनुताम् इमं नो विश्वे देवा इह मादयन्ताम् इति
3.18.90.m: Then within the altar he purifies himself with water [reciting]: 'May the light of mind enjoy the clarified butter! / May it unite this severed sacrifice! / May Bṛhaspati extend this for us; may all the gods rejoice here!'

3.18.91.s: barhiṣadaṃ puroḍāśam abhimantrayate bradhna pinvasva dadato me mā kṣāyi kurvato me mopadasat | iti |
3.18.91.d: बर्हिषदं पुरोडाशम् अभिमन्त्रयते ब्रध्न पिन्वस्व ददतो मे मा क्षायि कुर्वतो मे मोपदसत् । इति ।
3.18.91.m: He addresses the sacrificial cake resting on the sacrificial grass with: 'O brilliant one, swell! / To me as I give let there be no destruction; to me as I perform let there be no exhaustion!'

3.18.91.s: tam antarvedy āsannam abhimantrayate prajāpater bhāgo 'sy ūrjasvān payasvān ity āntād anuvākasya ||
3.18.91.d: तम् अन्तर्वेद्य् आसन्नम् अभिमन्त्रयते प्रजापतेर् भागो ऽस्य् ऊर्जस्वान् पयस्वान् इत्य् आन्ताद् अनुवाकस्य ॥
3.18.91.m: When it has been placed within the altar, he addresses it with: 'Thou art Prajāpati's portion, vigorous, rich in milk,' up to the end of the section.

3.19.91.s: anūyājānām iṣṭamiṣṭam anumantrayate barhiṣo 'haṃ devayajyayā prajāvān bhūyāsam | narāśam̐sasyāhaṃ devayajyayā paśumān bhūyāsam agneḥ sviṣṭakṛto 'haṃ devayajyayāyuṣmān yajñena pratiṣṭhāṃ gameyam iti |
3.19.91.d: अनूयाजानाम् इष्टमिष्टम् अनुमन्त्रयते बर्हिषो ऽहं देवयज्यया प्रजावान् भूयासम् । नराशँसस्याहं देवयज्यया पशुमान् भूयासम् अग्नेः स्विष्टकृतो ऽहं देवयज्ययायुष्मान् यज्ञेन प्रतिष्ठां गमेयम् इति ।
3.19.91.m: He accompanies each of the after-offerings after it has been offered with: 'Through the divine worship of the sacrificial grass may I become possessed of offspring! Through the divine worship of Narāśaṃsa may I become possessed of cattle! Through the divine worship of Agni Sviṣṭakṛt may I, possessed of long life, attain stability through the sacrifice!'

3.19.91.s: atha yatra hotur abhijānāti | agnir idaṃ havir ajuṣata | iti tad yajamānam ujjitiṃ vācayati | agner aham ujjitim anūjjeṣam iti yatheṣṭam
3.19.91.d: अथ यत्र होतुर् अभिजानाति । अग्निर् इदं हविर् अजुषत । इति तद् यजमानम् उज्जितिं वाचयति । अग्नेर् अहम् उज्जितिम् अनूज्जेषम् इति यथेष्टम्
3.19.91.m: Then, whenever he recognizes the hotṛ priest saying: 'Agni has enjoyed this oblation,' he makes the sacrificer recite the formula of triumph: 'May I triumph after Agni's triumph,' as each has been offered.

3.19.91.s: uktaṃ vājavatyor vyūhanam atha yatra hotur abhijānāti | āśāste 'yaṃ yajamāno 'sau | iti tad yajamānaṃ yajñasya dohaṃ vācayati | emā agmann āśiṣo dohakāmā indravanto vanāmahe dhukṣīmahi prajām iṣam iti
3.19.91.d: उक्तं वाजवत्योर् व्यूहनम् अथ यत्र होतुर् अभिजानाति । आशास्ते ऽयं यजमानो ऽसौ । इति तद् यजमानं यज्ञस्य दोहं वाचयति । एमा अग्मन्न् आशिषो दोहकामा इन्द्रवन्तो वनामहे धुक्षीमहि प्रजाम् इषम् इति
3.19.91.m: The shifting of the two vājavatī ladles has been explained. / Then, whenever he recognizes the hotṛ priest saying: 'This sacrificer, so-and-so, hopes for...', he makes the sacrificer recite the milking of the sacrifice: 'These hopes desiring milking have come; accompanied by Indra we ask, may we milk out offspring and food.'

3.19.91.s: prastaraṃ prahriyamāṇam anumantrayate rohitena tvāgnir devatāṃ gamayatu haribhyāṃ tvendro devatāṃ gamayatv etaśena tvā sūryo devatāṃ gamayatu | iti
3.19.91.d: प्रस्तरं प्रह्रियमाणम् अनुमन्त्रयते रोहितेन त्वाग्निर् देवतां गमयतु हरिभ्यां त्वेन्द्रो देवतां गमयत्व् एतशेन त्वा सूर्यो देवतां गमयतु । इति
3.19.91.m: While the grass bundle is being thrown [into the fire], he accompanies it with: 'May Agni with his red horse conduct thee to the deity; may Indra with his two bay horses conduct thee to the deity; may Sūrya with Etaśa conduct thee to the deity!'

3.19.91.s: paridhīn vimucyamānān anumantrayate vi te muñcāmi raśanā vi raśmīn vi yoktrā yāni paricartanāni | dhattād asmāsu draviṇaṃ yac ca bhadram | pra ṇo brūtād bhāgadhān devatāsu | iti
3.19.91.d: परिधीन् विमुच्यमानान् अनुमन्त्रयते वि ते मुञ्चामि रशना वि रश्मीन् वि योक्त्रा यानि परिचर्तनानि । धत्ताद् अस्मासु द्रविणं यच् च भद्रम् । प्र णो ब्रूताद् भागधान् देवतासु । इति
3.19.91.m: While the enclosing sticks are being untied, he accompanies them with: 'I loosen thy cords, thy reins, / the yoke-straps which are fastenings. / Bestow upon us property and whatever is auspicious; / proclaim our shares among the deities!'

3.19.91.s: śaṃyuvākam uktam anumantrayate viṣṇoḥ śaṃyor ahaṃ devayajyayā yajñena pratiṣṭhāṃ gameyam iti
3.19.91.d: शंयुवाकम् उक्तम् अनुमन्त्रयते विष्णोः शंयोर् अहं देवयज्यया यज्ञेन प्रतिष्ठां गमेयम् इति
3.19.91.m: After the śaṃyuvāka recitation has been spoken, he accompanies it with: 'Through the worship of the god Viṣṇu Śaṃyu may I attain stability through the sacrifice!'

3.19.92.m: He accompanies each of the offerings to the wives of the gods after it has been offered:

3.20.92.s: somasyāhaṃ devayajyayā suretā reto dhiṣīya tvaṣṭur ahaṃ devayajyayā paśūnām̐ rūpaṃ puṣeyam iti |
3.20.92.d: सोमस्याहं देवयज्यया सुरेता रेतो धिषीय त्वष्टुर् अहं देवयज्यया पशूनाँ रूपं पुषेयम् इति ।
3.20.92.m: 'Through the divine worship of Soma, being rich in seed, may I deposit seed! Through the divine worship of Tvaṣṭṛ may I nourish the form of cattle!'

3.20.92.s: athetarāv upasamasyati devānāṃ patvīr agnir gṛhapatir yajñasya mithunaṃ tayor ahaṃ devayajyayā mithunena prabhūyāsam iti
3.20.92.d: अथेतराव् उपसमस्यति देवानां पत्वीर् अग्निर् गृहपतिर् यज्ञस्य मिथुनं तयोर् अहं देवयज्यया मिथुनेन प्रभूयासम् इति
3.20.92.m: Then he combines the other two: 'The wives of the gods and Agni the householder are a pair of the sacrifice; through the divine worship of the two may I flourish with a pair!'

3.20.92.s: vede yajamānaṃ vācayati vedo 'si vittir asi videya | ity āntād anuvākasya
3.20.92.d: वेदे यजमानं वाचयति वेदो ऽसि वित्तिर् असि विदेय । इत्य् आन्ताद् अनुवाकस्य
3.20.92.m: Over the broom he makes the sacrificer recite: 'Thou art the broom; thou art finding; may I find...', up to the end of the section.

3.20.92.s: dhruvām āpyāyyamānām anumantrayate | āpyāyatāṃ dhruvā ghṛtena yajñaṃyajñaṃ prati devayadbhyaḥ | sūryāyā ūdho 'dityā upastha urudhārā pṛthivī yajñe asmin | iti |
3.20.92.d: ध्रुवाम् आप्याय्यमानाम् अनुमन्त्रयते । आप्यायतां ध्रुवा घृतेन यज्ञंयज्ञं प्रति देवयद्भ्यः । सूर्याया ऊधो ऽदित्या उपस्थ उरुधारा पृथिवी यज्ञे अस्मिन् । इति ।
3.20.92.m: While the dhruvā ladle is being replenished, he accompanies it with: 'May the dhruvā ladle swell with clarified butter at every sacrifice for the god-seeking worshippers! / The udder of Sūryā, the lap of Aditi, earth of broad streams at this sacrifice.'

3.20.92.s: atha yajamānabhāgaṃ prāśnāti prajāpater vibhān nāma lokas tasmim̐s tvā dadhāmi saha yajamānena | iti saṃ yajñapatir āśiṣā | iti vā |
3.20.92.d: अथ यजमानभागं प्राश्नाति प्रजापतेर् विभान् नाम लोकस् तस्मिँस् त्वा दधामि सह यजमानेन । इति सं यज्ञपतिर् आशिषा । इति वा ।
3.20.92.m: Then he consumes the sacrificer's portion with: 'In the world of Prajāpati named Vibhān I place thee along with the sacrificer,' or with: 'Together, the lord of the sacrifice with blessing...'
At this point he asks for this full vessel.

3.20.92.s: tam antarvedi nidhāya pūrṇapātre yajamānaṃ vācayati sad asi san me bhūyāḥ sarvasm asi sarvaṃ me bhūyāḥ pūrṇam asi pūrṇaṃ me bhūyā akṣitam asi mā me kṣeṣṭhās | iti |
3.20.92.d: तम् अन्तर्वेदि निधाय पूर्णपात्रे यजमानं वाचयति सद् असि सन् मे भूयाः सर्वस्म् असि सर्वं मे भूयाः पूर्णम् असि पूर्णं मे भूया अक्षितम् असि मा मे क्षेष्ठास् । इति ।
3.20.92.m: Having placed it within the altar, he makes the sacrificer recite over the full vessel: 'Thou art real, mayest thou be real for me! Thou art all, mayest thou be all for me! Thou art full, mayest thou be full for me! Thou art unexhausted, do not become exhausted for me!'

3.20.92.s: atha diśo vyunnayati prācyāṃ diśi devā ṛtvijo mārjayantāṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi māsāḥ pitaro mārjayantāṃ pratīcyāṃ diśi gṛhāḥ paśavo mārjayantām udīcyāṃ diśy āpa oṣadhayo vanaspatayo mārjayantām ūrdhvāyāṃ diśi yajñaḥ saṃvatsaro yajñapatir mārjayantām iti |
3.20.92.d: अथ दिशो व्युन्नयति प्राच्यां दिशि देवा ऋत्विजो मार्जयन्तां दक्षिणायां दिशि मासाः पितरो मार्जयन्तां प्रतीच्यां दिशि गृहाः पशवो मार्जयन्ताम् उदीच्यां दिश्य् आप ओषधयो वनस्पतयो मार्जयन्ताम् ऊर्ध्वायां दिशि यज्ञः संवत्सरो यज्ञपतिर् मार्जयन्ताम् इति ।
3.20.92.m: Then he raises water towards the quarters: 'In the eastern quarter may the gods and officiating priests cleanse themselves; in the southern quarter may the months and fathers cleanse themselves; in the western quarter may homes and cattle cleanse themselves; in the northern quarter may waters, plants, and trees cleanse themselves; in the upper quarter may the sacrifice, the year, and the lord of the sacrifice cleanse themselves!'

3.20.92.s: athainā ninayati samudraṃ vaḥ prahiṇomy akṣitāḥ svāṃ yonim apigacchata | acchidraḥ prajayā bhūyāsam | mā parāseci matpayas | iti |
3.20.92.d: अथैना निनयति समुद्रं वः प्रहिणोम्य् अक्षिताः स्वां योनिम् अपिगच्छत । अच्छिद्रः प्रजया भूयासम् । मा परासेचि मत्पयस् । इति ।
3.20.92.m: Then he pours it out: 'I send you to the ocean, unexhausted; / go to your own source! / May I be unbroken with offspring; / let not my milk be poured away!'

3.20.93.m: Then, having stood up, he strides the strides of Viṣṇu with the right foot,

3.21.93.s: viṣṇoḥ kramo 'sy abhimātihā gāyatreṇa chandasā pṛthivīm anu vikrame nirbhaktaḥ sa yaṃ dviṣmas | iti caturbhir anucchandasam |
3.21.93.d: विष्णोः क्रमो ऽस्य् अभिमातिहा गायत्रेण छन्दसा पृथिवीम् अनु विक्रमे निर्भक्तः स यं द्विष्मस् । इति चतुर्भिर् अनुच्छन्दसम् ।
3.21.93.m: with the four [formulas] corresponding to the metres: 'Thou art the stride of Viṣṇu, slaying rivals; after the earth do I stride with the gāyatrī metre; expelled is he whom we hate!'

3.21.93.s: tṛtīye caturtham anuvartayati na caturthāya prakrāmati nāhavanīyam upātyeti |
3.21.93.d: तृतीये चतुर्थम् अनुवर्तयति न चतुर्थाय प्रक्रामति नाहवनीयम् उपात्येति ।
3.21.93.m: With the third, he makes the fourth follow; he does not stride forth for a fourth [stride]; he does not step beyond the āhavanīya fire.

3.21.93.s: athātraiva tiṣṭhann āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhate | aganma suvaḥ suvar aganma saṃdṛśas te mā chitsi yat te tapas tasmai te māvṛkṣi | iti |
3.21.93.d: अथात्रैव तिष्ठन्न् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते । अगन्म सुवः सुवर् अगन्म संदृशस् ते मा छित्सि यत् ते तपस् तस्मै ते मावृक्षि । इति ।
3.21.93.m: Then, standing right there, he attends upon the āhavanīya fire with: ‘We have attained heaven, heaven have we attained; may I not be cut off from the sight of you; may I not be harmed by your heat!’

3.21.93.s: athādityam upatiṣṭhate subhūr asi śreṣṭho raśmīnām āyurdhā asy āyur me dhehi varcodhā asi varco mayi dhehi | iti |
3.21.93.d: अथादित्यम् उपतिष्ठते सुभूर् असि श्रेष्ठो रश्मीनाम् आयुर्धा अस्य् आयुर् मे धेहि वर्चोधा असि वर्चो मयि धेहि । इति ।
3.21.93.m: Then he attends upon the sun with: ‘You are the well-born, the best of rays, the bestower of life; bestow life upon me! You are the bestower of luster; bestow luster upon me!’

3.21.93.s: athaibhyo lokebhyo bhrātṛvyaṃ nirbhajati | idam aham amuṃ bhrātṛvyam ābhyo digbhyo 'syai divo 'smād antarikṣād asyai pṛthivyā asmād annādyān nirbhajāmi nirbhaktaḥ sa yaṃ dviṣmas | iti |
3.21.93.d: अथैभ्यो लोकेभ्यो भ्रातृव्यं निर्भजति । इदम् अहम् अमुं भ्रातृव्यम् आभ्यो दिग्भ्यो ऽस्यै दिवो ऽस्माद् अन्तरिक्षाद् अस्यै पृथिव्या अस्माद् अन्नाद्यान् निर्भजामि निर्भक्तः स यं द्विष्मस् । इति ।
