4.3.112.d: बर्हिषी अन्तर्धाय दध्य् आनयति । ऋध्यासम् अद्य पृषतीनां ग्रहं पृषतीनां ग्रहो ऽसि । इति ।
4.3.112.m: Interposing two stalks of sacrificial grass, he pours the curd with: 'May I prosper today the cup of speckled [cows]; you are the cup of speckled [cows].'

4.3.112.s: apoddhṛtya barhiṣī athābhighārayati viṣṇor hṛdayam asi | iti |
4.3.112.d: अपोद्धृत्य बर्हिषी अथाभिघारयति विष्णोर् हृदयम् असि । इति ।
4.3.112.m: Having removed the two stalks of sacrificial grass, he then bastes it with: 'You are the heart of Viṣṇu.'

4.3.112.s: ekam iṣa viṣṇus tvānu vicakrame | iti dvitīyam ||
4.3.112.d: एकम् इष विष्णुस् त्वानु विचक्रमे । इति द्वितीयम् ॥
4.3.112.m: A second [basting] with: 'Viṣṇu strode after you for a single nourishment.'

4.4.112.s: atha prokṣaṇībhir upottiṣṭhatīdhmaṃ prokṣati vediṃ prokṣati barhiḥ prokṣati
4.4.112.d: अथ प्रोक्षणीभिर् उपोत्तिष्ठतीध्मं प्रोक्षति वेदिं प्रोक्षति बर्हिः प्रोक्षति
4.4.112.m: Then he stands up with the sprinkling waters. He sprinkles the kindling wood; he sprinkles the altar; he sprinkles the sacrificial grass.

4.4.112.s: barhir āsannaṃ prokṣyopaninīya purastāt prastaraṃ gṛhṇāti
4.4.112.d: बर्हिर् आसन्नं प्रोक्ष्योपनिनीय पुरस्तात् प्रस्तरं गृह्णाति
4.4.112.m: Having sprinkled the sacrificial grass that has been placed, having poured [water] down [beside it], he takes the grass bundle from the front.

4.4.113.s: pañcavidhaṃ barhi stīrtvā prastarapāṇiḥ prāṅ abhisṛpya kārṣmaryamayān paridhīn paridadhāti |
4.4.113.d: पञ्चविधं बर्हि स्तीर्त्वा प्रस्तरपाणिः प्राङ् अभिसृप्य कार्ष्मर्यमयान् परिधीन् परिदधाति ।
4.4.113.m: Having strewn the sacrificial grass fivefold, with the grass bundle in hand, creeping forward toward the east, he lays the enclosing sticks made of kārṣmarya wood around [the fire].

4.4.113.s: ūrdhve samidhāv ādadhāti vidhṛtī tiraścī sādayati
4.4.113.d: ऊर्ध्वे समिधाव् आदधाति विधृती तिरश्ची सादयति
4.4.113.m: He places two upright kindling sticks. He places two crosswise dividing-blades.
Upon the two dividing-blades, the grass bundle; upon the grass bundle, the juhū ladle; the other [ladles] upon the sacrificial grass.

4.4.113.s: etā asadan | iti samabhimṛśya pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya pratyaṅṅ ādrutya yācati yavamatīḥ prokṣaṇīr barhirhastam ājyasthālīm̐ sasruvām̐ svaruraśanaṃ maitrāvaruṇadaṇḍaṃ yūpaśakalam̐ hiraṇyam udapātram iti |
4.4.113.d: एता असदन् । इति समभिमृश्य प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य प्रत्यङ्ङ् आद्रुत्य याचति यवमतीः प्रोक्षणीर् बर्हिर्हस्तम् आज्यस्थालीँ सस्रुवाँ स्वरुरशनं मैत्रावरुणदण्डं यूपशकलँ हिरण्यम् उदपात्रम् इति ।
4.4.113.m: Having touched them with: 'These have sat down,' having turned clockwise, having run westward, he calls for: the sprinkling waters with barley, a handful of sacrificial grass, the ghee-pot with the dipping-spoon, the chip of the sacrificial post and the cord, the staff for the Maitrāvaruṇa priest, a chip of the sacrificial post, gold, and a water-pot.

4.4.113.s: etat saṃnidhāya yūpaṃ prakṣālayati yat te śikvaḥ parāvadhīt takṣā hastena vāsyā | āpas te tad vanaspate 'panudantu śundhanīs | iti
4.4.113.d: एतत् संनिधाय यूपं प्रक्षालयति यत् ते शिक्वः परावधीत् तक्षा हस्तेन वास्या । आपस् ते तद् वनस्पते ऽपनुदन्तु शुन्धनीस् । इति
4.4.113.m: Having brought these together, he washes the sacrificial post with: 'What the skilful carpenter with his hand and axe has cut away from you, / let the waters, the purifying ones, wipe that away from you, O tree!'

4.4.113.s: yūpa eṣa prakṣālitaḥ prapannaḥ saṃpannacaṣālaḥ prāg avaṭād upaśete
4.4.113.d: यूप एष प्रक्षालितः प्रपन्नः संपन्नचषालः प्राग् अवटाद् उपशेते
4.4.113.m: This sacrificial post, washed, brought forward, fitted with its top-ring, lies to the east of the pit.

4.4.113.s: tam uttareṇāhavanīyaṃ tiṣṭhan parāñcaṃ prokṣati pṛthivyai tvāntarikṣāya tvā dive tvā | ity avaṭe 'po 'vanayati śundhatāṃ lokaḥ pitṛṣadanas | iti
4.4.113.d: तम् उत्तरेणाहवनीयं तिष्ठन् पराञ्चं प्रोक्षति पृथिव्यै त्वान्तरिक्षाय त्वा दिवे त्वा । इत्य् अवटे ऽपो ऽवनयति शुन्धतां लोकः पितृषदनस् । इति
4.4.113.m: Standing to the north of the āhavanīya fire, he sprinkles it turning away with: 'For earth thee! For intermediate space thee! For heaven thee!' He pours water into the pit with: 'Let the seat of the fathers be purified!'

4.4.113.s: yavān praskandayati yavo 'si yavayāsmad dveṣo yavayārātīs | iti
4.4.113.d: यवान् प्रस्कन्दयति यवो ऽसि यवयास्मद् द्वेषो यवयारातीस् । इति
4.4.113.m: He scatters barley grains with: 'You are barley; keep hatred away from us, keep enemies away!'

4.4.113.s: barhirhastaṃ vyatiṣajyāvastṛṇāti pitṛṇām̐ sadanam asi | iti |
4.4.113.d: बर्हिर्हस्तं व्यतिषज्यावस्तृणाति पितृणाँ सदनम् असि । इति ।
4.4.113.m: Entwining the handful of sacrificial grass, he strews it down [in the pit] with: 'You are the seat of the fathers.'

4.4.113.s: yūpaśakalam avāsyati svāveśo 'syagregā netṛṇāṃ vanaspatiradhi tvā sthāsyati tasya vittāt | iti |
4.4.113.d: यूपशकलम् अवास्यति स्वावेशो ऽस्यग्रेगा नेतृणां वनस्पतिरधि त्वा स्थास्यति तस्य वित्तात् । इति ।
4.4.113.m: He throws down a chip of the sacrificial post with: 'You are a good dwelling; going first among the leaders, the tree will stand upon you; know of it!'

4.4.113.s: athādatta ājyasthālīm̐ sasruvām̐ svaruraśanaṃ maitrāvaruṇadaṇḍam udapātram iti |
4.4.113.d: अथादत्त आज्यस्थालीँ सस्रुवाँ स्वरुरशनं मैत्रावरुणदण्डम् उदपात्रम् इति ।
4.4.113.m: Then he takes the ghee-pot with the dipping-spoon, the chip of the post and the cord, the staff for the Maitrāvaruṇa priest, and the water-pot.
Having taken these, he says: 'Come, sacrificer!'

4.4.113.s: anvag yajamāno 'nūcī patny agreṇa yūpaṃ parītya dakṣiṇata udaṅmukhās tiṣṭhanti pūrva evādhvaryur aparo yajamāno 'parā patnī
4.4.113.d: अन्वग् यजमानो ऽनूची पत्न्य् अग्रेण यूपं परीत्य दक्षिणत उदङ्मुखास् तिष्ठन्ति पूर्व एवाध्वर्युर् अपरो यजमानो ऽपरा पत्नी
4.4.113.m: The sacrificer behind him, the wife behind [the sacrificer], having gone around the front of the sacrificial post, they stand to the south facing north: the adhvaryu priest first, the sacrificer behind [him], the wife behind [the sacrificer].

4.4.114.s: atha pravṛhya caṣālaṃ yūpasyāgram anakti devas tvā savitā madhvānaktu | ity antarataś ca bāhyataś ca
4.4.114.d: अथ प्रवृह्य चषालं यूपस्याग्रम् अनक्ति देवस् त्वा सविता मध्वानक्तु । इत्य् अन्तरतश् च बाह्यतश् च
4.4.114.m: Then, having pulled off the top-ring, he anoints the top of the sacrificial post with: 'May the divine Savitar anoint you with honey,' both on the inside and on the outside.

4.4.114.s: svabhyaktaṃ kṛtvā caṣālaṃ pratimuñcati supippalābhyas tvauṣadhībhyas | iti |
4.4.114.d: स्वभ्यक्तं कृत्वा चषालं प्रतिमुञ्चति सुपिप्पलाभ्यस् त्वौषधीभ्यस् । इति ।
4.4.114.m: Having made it well-anointed, he fits the top-ring onto it with: 'For plants rich in good fruit [thee].'

4.4.114.s: atha sruveṇāgniṣṭhām aśrim abhighārayann āha yūpāyājyamānāyānubrūhi | iti |
4.4.114.d: अथ स्रुवेणाग्निष्ठाम् अश्रिम् अभिघारयन्न् आह यूपायाज्यमानायानुब्रूहि । इति ।
4.4.114.m: Then, basting the corner facing the fire with the dipping-spoon, he says: 'Recite for the sacrificial post being anointed!'

4.4.114.s: āntam anakty āntam eva yajamānaṃ tejasānakti noparam anakti
4.4.114.d: आन्तम् अनक्त्य् आन्तम् एव यजमानं तेजसानक्ति नोपरम् अनक्ति
4.4.114.m: 'He anoints down to the end; down to the end he anoints the sacrificer with fiery brilliance.' He does not anoint the lower part.

4.4.114.s: patny uparam anakti sarvataḥ parimṛśaty aparivargam evāsmin tejo dadhāti | iti brāhmaṇam
4.4.114.d: पत्न्य् उपरम् अनक्ति सर्वतः परिमृशत्य् अपरिवर्गम् एवास्मिन् तेजो दधाति । इति ब्राह्मणम्
4.4.114.m: The wife anoints the lower part. 'He strokes all around; without omission he places fiery brilliance in him'—thus the brāhmaṇa passage.

4.4.114.s: ucchrayann āha | ucchrīyamāṇāyānubrūhi | iti | ucchrayati | ud divam̐ stabhānāntarikṣaṃ pṛṇa pṛthivīm upareṇa dṛm̐ha | iti |
4.4.114.d: उच्छ्रयन्न् आह । उच्छ्रीयमाणायानुब्रूहि । इति । उच्छ्रयति । उद् दिवँ स्तभानान्तरिक्षं पृण पृथिवीम् उपरेण दृँह । इति ।
4.4.114.m: Erecting [the post], he says: 'Recite for [the post] being erected!' He erects it with: 'Prop up the sky, fill the intermediate space, make the earth firm with your lower part!'

4.4.114.s: athainaṃ vaiṣṇavībhyām ṛgbhyāṃ kalpayati te te dhāmāni viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata | iti dvābhyām |
4.4.114.d: अथैनं वैष्णवीभ्याम् ऋग्भ्यां कल्पयति ते ते धामानि विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत । इति द्वाभ्याम् ।
4.4.114.m: Then he adjusts it with two verses to Viṣṇu: 'Those abodes of yours...' and 'Behold the deeds of Viṣṇu...'—with these two.

4.4.114.s: sa yatrāgniṣṭhām aśrim āhavanīyena saṃpādayati tad dhruvasya caṣālaṃ parekṣayati tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam̐ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ | divīva cakṣur ātatam iti |
4.4.114.d: स यत्राग्निष्ठाम् अश्रिम् आहवनीयेन संपादयति तद् ध्रुवस्य चषालं परेक्षयति तद् विष्णोः परमं पदँ सदा पश्यन्ति सूरयः । दिवीव चक्षुर् आततम् इति ।
4.4.114.m: When he makes the corner facing the fire align with the āhavanīya fire, he then inspects the top-ring of the firm [post] with: 'That supreme step of Viṣṇu the patrons ever behold, / like an eye stretched across the sky.'

4.4.114.s: athainaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ purīṣeṇa paryūhati brahmavaniṃ tvā kṣatravanim̐ suprajāvanim̐ rāyaspoṣavaniṃ paryūhāmi | iti
4.4.114.d: अथैनं प्रदक्षिणं पुरीषेण पर्यूहति ब्रह्मवनिं त्वा क्षत्रवनिँ सुप्रजावनिँ रायस्पोषवनिं पर्यूहामि । इति
4.4.114.m: Then he banks it around clockwise with loose earth with: 'Winning the priesthood, winning the nobility, winning good offspring, winning abundance of wealth, I bank you around.'

4.4.114.s: maitrāvaruṇadaṇḍena sam̐hanti brahma dṛm̐ha kṣatraṃ dṛm̐ha prajāṃ dṛm̐ha rāyaspoṣaṃ dṛm̐ha | iti |
4.4.114.d: मैत्रावरुणदण्डेन सँहन्ति ब्रह्म दृँह क्षत्रं दृँह प्रजां दृँह रायस्पोषं दृँह । इति ।
4.4.114.m: He rams it firm with the staff for the Maitrāvaruṇa priest with: 'Make firm the priesthood, make firm the nobility, make firm the offspring, make firm the abundance of wealth!'

4.4.114.s: anyūnam anatiriktaṃ parinyasyodapātram upaninīyāthaitāṃ triguṇām̐ raśanāṃ triḥ saṃbhujya madhyamena guṇena nābhidaghne parivyayann āha parivīyamāṇāyānubrūhi | iti
4.4.114.d: अन्यूनम् अनतिरिक्तं परिन्यस्योदपात्रम् उपनिनीयाथैतां त्रिगुणाँ रशनां त्रिः संभुज्य मध्यमेन गुणेन नाभिदघ्ने परिव्ययन्न् आह परिवीयमाणायानुब्रूहि । इति
4.4.114.m: Having heaped [earth] around neither deficiently nor excessively, having poured down the water-pot, then folding this threefold cord three times, girding it at navel-height with the middle strand, he says: 'Recite for [the post] being girded!'

4.4.114.s: triḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ parivyayati parivīr asi pari tvā daivīr viśo vyayantāṃ parīmam̐ rāyaspoṣo yajamānaṃ manuṣyai | iti |
4.4.114.d: त्रिः प्रदक्षिणं परिव्ययति परिवीर् असि परि त्वा दैवीर् विशो व्ययन्तां परीमँ रायस्पोषो यजमानं मनुष्यै । इति ।
4.4.114.m: He girds it three times clockwise with: 'You are the girding cord; may the divine clans gird you; may abundance of wealth gird this sacrificer among men.'
He tucks [the ends] near the edge; he tucks them in to the end.

4.4.114.s: aṇimati sthavimat pravayati | athottareṇāgniṣṭhām aśriṃ madhyame guṇe svarum avagūhati | antarikṣasya tvā sānāv avagūhāmi | iti
4.4.114.d: अणिमति स्थविमत् प्रवयति । अथोत्तरेणाग्निष्ठाम् अश्रिं मध्यमे गुणे स्वरुम् अवगूहति । अन्तरिक्षस्य त्वा सानाव् अवगूहामि । इति
4.4.114.m: He weaves the thicker [end] into the thinner. Then, to the north of the corner facing the fire, he inserts the chip of the post into the middle strand with: 'I insert you into the ridge of the intermediate space.'
He lets go of the sacrificial post with its chip.
